Taiyo Yuden share price risk/reward: We upgrade Taiyo Yuden from UW to EW, as we
believe its share price, having fallen 56.0% from its July 1 peak, has limited downside risk

and offers 6% upside over the next 12-18 months. We lower our DCF-based price target
from ¥12,500 to ¥10,500. This mainly reflects an increase in the DCF model’s risk-free
rate from 2.60% to 3.0%. We rate the stock EW rather than OW because: (1) In its core
MLCC business, we estimate Taiyo Yuden's MLCC market share was 11.3% in 2025, down
from 12.7% in 2020, and we think this downtrend continued into 2026, with its market
share shrinking to 10.7% in 1Q and 9.9% in 2Q. (2) We believe Taiyo Yuden is lagging

behind Murata (No. 1 share) and SEMCO (No. 2) in small, high-capacity MLCCs for AI
server accelerator boards, where demand is rapidly expanding. (3) We expect consensus
estimates for F3/28 onward to be revised down after 2Q results.
Bull case ¥14,000, 49% projected upside
In our bull case, F3/27 sales of MLCCs for AI servers/data centers are 7% higher than in our
base case, for OP of ¥56.5bn in F3/27, ¥85.5bn in F3/28, and ¥176.3bn in F3/31. Our forex

assumptions and DCF assumptions match our base case. Bull case fair value corresponds
to 50.7x our fully-diluted F3/27 EPS estimate of ¥276.1, 33.6x our fully-diluted F3/28 EPS
estimate of ¥417.0, and 15.9x our full-diluted F3/31 EPS estimate of ¥879.1.
Bear case ¥4,500
Taiyo Yuden’s care products (MLCCs and inductors) are used in all kinds of electronic
devices, and are easily affected by the macro economy and inventory cycle. In our bear
case, we assume slower global economic growth rates and lower production of high-end

consumer goods like high-end smartphones than in our base case, for OP of ¥39.2bn in
F3/27, ¥56.1bn in F3/28, and ¥65.8bn in F3/31. Our forex assumptions and DCF
assumptions are the same as in our base case. Here we look for ROE of 7.3% in F3/27 and
10.1% in F3/28, improving to a level above capital cost of 7.9%. With profit below market
expectations, we assume the share price falls to a P/B of 1.8x.

Global Research
First Read
Voltronic Power
UBS Taiwan Summit 2026 key takeaways:
Earnings growth hinges on UPS/HVDC deliveries
Sales turning to growth in H226; sales mix change driving margin expansion
Management indicated bookings and shipments remained solid in July-Aug despite
temporary PCB shortages, and it expects a sales turnaround to growth in H226. Inverter
sales could stay weak on competition and Voltronic's product portfolio adjustments

(reducing low-margin products). Meanwhile, increasing outsourcing by brands will
support UPS sales growth. Management expects HVDC products to start contributing in
2027. Voltronic added a third customer for HVDC products. We think a higher sales
portion from UPS/HVDC products and inverter product adjustments could bring GM
expansion in 2027.
UPS growth intact;  HVDC and PDU represent the next legs of growth
The company expects sales to resume growth by single digits  in H226  and expects >10%

YoY growth in 2027. Management remains cautious about solar  inverters due to intense
competition from Chinese peers and expects inverter sales to decline as Voltronic adjusts
its product portfolio, focusing more on commercial solar  and premium products. For
2027, management expects offline UPS to grow 0-5%, supported by outsourcing
opportunities and emerging market demand, which could offset notebook weakness.
High-power UPS could account for an increasingly higher sales portion, driven by

accelerating outsourcing by tier 1 customers. For HVDC, management highlighted it
obtained one more client. HVDC product progress is on schedule, with 800VDC power
shelf sampling expected by year-end, a pilot run in H127 and mass production in H227.
The company is preparing testing and production equipment at factories in Taiwan and
China. Over the longer term, management also sees opportunities in PDUs, a market it
estimates at US$5bn in 2025, with a 12-15% sales CAGR over the next 5-8 years.

Margin  improvement on product mix optimisation and higher prices
Voltronic has implemented two UPS price increases this year to offset higher raw
material costs, which it expects to be reflected on its P&L starting in Sept 2026. For solar
inverters, management plans to focus on higher power and premium products with a
GM above 20%, while reducing low-power products with a GM at or below 20% over
the next two to three quarters, which could support GM expansion. In upcoming

quarters, solar inverter products may shrink to <20% of the total sales mix, while higher-
margin businesses such as high-power UPS and HVDC products continue to ramp. We
think the sales mix change will expand margins in 2027.
Valuation: Maintain Buy rating and PT of NT$1,128
We maintain our Buy rating and price target of NT$1,128, based on sum-of-the-parts
analysis, applying 28x/23x/24x 2027E PE for UPS/inverter/PSU business, respectively.

Company Description
Founded in 2008, Voltronic is a leading ODM for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) and
inverters. Its major customers include Schneider, Vertiv, and Riello. Voltronic is headquartered
in Taiwan and has production plants in mainland China, Vietnam, and Taiwan.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement

We base our price target on sum of the parts.
We believe the key risks for Voltronic include: 1) a slower-than-expected outsourcing trend
from leading branded UPS companies; 2) a faster-than-expected ramp-up of the electricity
grid in developing countries resulting in lower-than-expected demand for off-grid solar
systems; 3) FX risks; and 4) rising raw material prices.
Key industry-specific risks include: 1) unexpected changes in the underlying global

macroeconomic environment; 2) currency and interest rate movement; and 3) commodity
price inflation.

### Page 3

We see several indicators suggesting strong ABF equipment demand, including (1) the 
lead time for ABF vacuum laminators has extended into 2031, implying ~1.5k units of 
mid-to-high end equipment orders (assuming UTR is full for Eternal Precision’s capacity 
in both Japan and China throughout 2027-31), vs. ~600 units of total equipment 
shipped during 2022-25. This suggests demand for ABF equipment is strengthening 
(even stronger than previous upcycle in 2020-22) and shifting toward higher-end 
(management mentioned that the four major Taiwanese ABF customers mainly ordered 
the 90-ton 3-stage vacuum laminators for new capacity expansions), (2) Eternal 
Precision has seen some customers voluntarily offer to pay a premium to secure 
equipment supply and shorten the long lead time, a trend that was not observed by the 
company during the last upcycle, and (3) contract liabilities uptrend has just started 
(Exhibit 2), and we expect to see even stronger growth in coming years considering the 
upcoming ABF substrate industry capacity expansion trend (from 2027 to at least 2031, 
Exhibit 3) 
The extended order lead time for the key ABF equipment supports our positive view on 
the ABF substrate industry. ABF suppliers remain proactive in capacity expansion, but 
demand continues to outpace supply, thus we expect the shortage ratio of ABF 
substrates could reach 14%/34%/51% in 2H26/2027/2028 (see here). We see limited 
risk from capacity expansion by China ABF suppliers due to their limited access to new 
ABF equipment. Eternal Precision has seen some China ABF customers offering 
premiums to shorten equipment lead time, but the company mentioned that they 
prioritize major customers, as well as those with secured ABF film supply (we continue to 
see limitations on ABF film supply for China ABF suppliers). Meanwhile, more 
end-customers are asking key ABF suppliers for capacity beyond 2029, consistent with 
the fact that major ABF suppliers have better access to key ABF equipment. 
In terms of future substrate products, Unimicron previously mentioned that MP 
shipment of EMIB-T substrates could start in 2027 (see here). While Japanese ABF 
suppliers will be the first to have access to the new ABF vacuum laminators for EMIB-T 
substrates given their better production yields, Unimicron is tracking close by targeting a 
50% yield for this new product. For the more advanced glass core substrates, we 
continue to see Kinsus and Unimicron making progress with this new technology (see 
here and here), while commercialization is unlikely in the near term (beyond 2029 per 
GSe). Overall, we believe that the most advanced packaging substrates could become a 
key revenue/GM driver in the longer term given their better pricing/margin profile (most 
advanced packaging substrates typically have GM of 60%+ upon MP vs. 
Kinsus/Unimicron GM at 26.1%/24.8% as of 2Q26). 
Maintain our Buy ratings on NYPCB (on CL) and Kinsus, but stay Neutral on Unimicron, 
with unchanged 12m TPs for NYPCB/Kinsus/Unimicron of 
NT$2,500/NT$1,125/NT$1,220.  
Investment Thesis & PT methodology and risks

Investment Thesis - NYPCB 
NYPCB manufactures and markets printed circuit boards (PCBs) and integrated circuit 
(IC) substrates (including ABF and BT substrates). We are Buy-rated on NYPCB

### Page 4

considering the company’s high exposure to BT substrates and non-LTA ABF substrate
(70%+ of total revenue), where we expect GM/OPM to increase significantly in the
coming quarters (from breakeven in OPM in 1H25 to 27/41% in 2026/27E) due to the
favorable substrate pricing outlook. Despite the company’s low exposure to high-end
ABF substrate industry (<20% of total revenue in 1H25), we believe the expanding
demand from ASIC AI server and high-end switch IC demand will drive the company’s

high-end ABF revenue exposure to 40%+ by 2027E, suggesting better GM/OPM outlook
in the long term. In 2H25-2H26, we believe NYPCB will continue to benefit from stronger
ABF/BT pricing and should be a key beneficiary of the pricing uptrend considering the
company’s key focus on BT and non-LTA ABF substrate industries. Moreover, in the long
term (after 2026), we expect the ABF industry to return to supply tightness, and NYPCB’s
expanding high-end exposure will lead to a long-term earnings growth outlook (122%

2026-28E earnings CAGR). As a result, we see solid upside potential for NYPCB’s
earnings and stock performance.
Price Target Risks and Methodology - NYPCB
Valuation methodology: Our 12-month target price of NT$2,500 for NYPCB is based
on 21x 2028E P/E, which is +1.5x STDV higher than the past upcycle average P/E (13.3x).
Key downside risks: (1) Slower-than-expected PC demand recovery, (2)
Slower-than-expected ABF substrates pricing upgrading outlook, and (3)

Slower-than-expected NYPCB new high-end capacity qualification progress.
Investment Thesis - Kinsus
Kinsus is one of the key IC substrates suppliers globally with ~10% ABF/BT substrates
market share in 2024, with ~18% of total 2025 revenue contributed by its contact lens
subsidiary, Pegavision (6941.TW, Not Covered). With our view that the ABF substrate
shortage started from 2Q26 (ABF substrate return to supply demand balance from late
2025), we believe Kinsus’ performance will continue to improve compared with high-end

ABF peers considering the company’s increasing market share in the high-end ABF
substrate market; however, ~36% of the company’s revenue was contributed by BT
substrates in 2025 and 30% of the company’s ABF revenue is from non-LTA customers,
which we believe will continue to enjoy a better pricing outlook. As a result, we believe
Kinsus’ earnings outlook should continue to be strong (~106% 2026-29E CAGR), mainly
driven by better BT substrate and non-LTA ABF substrate pricing outlook, despite the

unfavorable demand outlook before 2H26. We believe Kinsus is an experienced
substrate supplier with a clear capacity expansion plan that can also upgrade its product
portfolio in the long term. We believe we are at the beginning of an industry upcycle,
making us positive on Kinsus’ stock performance over the next 12 months.
Price Target Risks and Methodology - Kinsus
Valuation methodology: Our 12-month target price of NT$1,125 for Kinsus is based on

16.5x 2028E P/E, which is +1.2x STDV higher than Kinsus’ past upcycle average P/E
(14.2x).
Key downside risks: (1) Slower-than-expected PC demand recovery, (2)
Slower-than-expected ABF substrates pricing upgrading outlook, (3)
Slower/Less-than-expected AI server orders from 2H26.

### Page 5

Investment Thesis - Unimicron Technology
Unimicron is a key supplier of ABF substrates (25% market share in 2025) and BT
substrates and also produces FPC/HDI/PCB products. We are Neutral rated on the
shares given long-term growth opportunity prospects: (1) over 70% of ABF shipments
are covered by long-term agreements (LTA), which limits pricing flexibility and makes
price hike less likely; (2) the company’s execution track record has been weaker than

peers; (3) capacity expansion plan remains slower than peers, constraining its ability to
capture incremental AI demand. The current ABF substrates market is seeing more
favorable supply demand outlook, and Unimicron is likely to see better pricing outlook
to reflect rising material costs in the coming quarters. AI ABF account for 10% of the
company’s total revenue, but the growth is likely to be slower than peers due to the
company continuing to lose market share to peers given its less favourable production

yield and slow capacity expansion. Overall, we are Neutral rated on Unimicron given our
outlook for limited upside potential, barring ASIC AI servers, despite our generally
positive view in the long term on its profitability trajectory.
Price Target Risks and Methodology - Unimicron Technology
Valuation methodology: Our 12-month target price of NT$1,220 for Unimicron is
based on 17.4x 2028E P/E, which is 2.7x STDV higher than the past upcycle average P/E

(10.3x).
Key upside/downside risks: (1) Slower/faster-than-expected PC demand recovery, (2)
Slower/faster-than-expected ABF substrates upgrading pace, and (3) Slower/faster
than-expected AI server PCB market share loss progress.

3
Asia Vital Components (3017.TW)
Buy | TP NT$4,350.00 from NT$3,800.00 | Price NT$3,185.00 (17 Sep 26 13:30)
Sequential growth intact, ASIC carrying the upside — Our checks and mgmt.
comments indicate Vera Rubin platform has begun contributing in small volumes
from Sep, with a further ramp expected in 4Q26E. The ongoing ASIC project is now
shifting progressively from air cooling to liquid cooling, while another ASIC project

enters mass production in 4Q26E, together the main growth drivers as new
capacity comes online through the quarter. We now forecast 3Q26E/4Q26E
revenue growth at 18%/12% QoQ. GPM should also improve on a sequential basis,
supported by yield improvement and a rising contribution from server and liquid
cooling products.
ASIC contribution could exceed 50% of liquid cooling revenue in 2027 — With
cold plate demand continuing to run ahead of supply, we expect AVC to undertake

another round of capacity expansion in 2027 to meet rising ASIC demand,
consistent with mgmt. ’s view that ASIC contribution catches up with GPU in 2027.
We also note ongoing discussion around double-sided cold plate adoption, with
several platforms at the R&D stage, which we see as a source of upside
momentum. Rubin Ultra spec remains under development, and we do not expect
the potential TDP adjustments toward a lower level to affect content value, as cold

plate content is driven more by design than by chip TDP itself. On a higher liquid
cooling contribution, we forecast 2027E revenue to grow another 50% YoY, with
GPM to further increase to 34.9% (+2.2ppts YoY).
Implications — We raise our 2026E/27E/28E earnings forecasts by 3%/13%/16% to
reflect the updated outlook, driven mainly by higher cold plate capacity and
shipment assumptions alongside a more constructive view on ASIC liquid cooling
demand. Our revised target price of NT$4,350 (from NT$3,800) remains based on

25x 2027E EPS. Given AVC’s position in the thermal sector and its valuation
following the recent share price pullback, we see a favorable risk-reward profile and
reiterate our Buy rating.

Auras Technology (3324.TWO)
Buy | TP NT$1,800.00 from NT$1,550.00 | Price NT$1,385.00 (17 Sep 26 15:00)
Liquid cooling ramp drives sequential acceleration into 4Q26 — Following Aug-
26 revenue, which pulled back from a high base in Jul-26, we believe Auras remains
on track to meet mgmt. ’s earlier guidance of at least 15% QoQ growth in 3Q26E.
Into 4Q26, shipments of Vera Rubin products, including inner/rack manifolds,

together with the start of mass production for liquid cooling version of ASIC
project, should allow Auras to deliver another solid sequential growth. We now
forecast 3Q26E/4Q26E revenue growth of 17%/16% QoQ, with GPM also on an
upward trend, supported by a higher liquid cooling revenue mix.
GPU & ASIC projects broaden the 2027 growth base — Our checks and mgmt.
comments  indicate Auras is still working through cold plate qualification for the
Vera Rubin platform and is now participating in next generation product

development. Given its operating scale, we believe even a modest share gain could
contribute meaningfully to its top line, and we expect the earliest potential
contribution from 1Q27E. Auras should also benefit from rising ASIC liquid cooling
demand, with existing ASIC project shipments to expand above 4Q26E levels and
several further projects now under discussion. We forecast 2027E revenue growth
of 35% YoY, with liquid cooling mix rising from 61% in 2026E to 70% in 2027E and

GPM reaching 31.3% (+1.2ppts YoY).
Implications — We raise our 2026E/27E/28E earnings forecasts by 2%/14%/17% to
reflect the updated outlook, driven mainly by higher cold plate shipment
assumptions alongside a more constructive view on ASIC liquid cooling demand.
Our revised target price of NT$1,800 (from NT$1,550) remains based on 20x 2027E
EPS. Given Auras’ structural growth in the server business, widening liquid cooling
content across both GPU and ASIC platforms, and an optimizing global

manufacturing footprint in Thailand, we view the current valuation as attractive
and reiterate our Buy rating.

Asia Vital Components
Company description
Asia Vital Components (AVC), founded in 1991, is a global leader in thermal
solutions, originally focusing on PCs but now specializing in servers and
networking. With Furukawa Electric (Japan) as its largest shareholder, AVC
provides a comprehensive range of cooling components, including vapor
chambers (VCs), fans, cold plates, CDUs, and manifolds, as well as chassis

and assembly services for PCs and servers, enabling holistic thermal solution
designs and one-stop shop services. AVC's diverse product portfolio supports
various sectors, including consumer IT, cloud infrastructure, transportation,
energy and networking.
Investment strategy
We rate AVC a Buy. AVC is well-positioned for the liquid-cooling transition,
with leadership in cold plates and broad participation across Nvidia and CSP
projects. Its high-volume machining capability, manufacturing uniformity,

and Vietnam-based capacity provide it with a defensible position as
Blackwell and future deployments expand. The company captures a wider
share of the thermal BOM, across coldplates, manifolds, QDs, and CDU
opportunities, providing a multi-layered earnings engine.
Valuation
We value AVC using a PE-based approach that factors in earnings momentum
and the expansion of its addressable market. Our TP of NT$4,350 is derived
from applying a 25x PE multiple on 2027E EPS, which we believe is justified

given the company’s entrenched positioned in the server thermal segment,
rising contribution from liquid cooling, and the increasing value of thermal
content per server as power density continues to climb. With these structural
drivers still in place, we expect the multiple to hold at a premium relative to its
historical averages.
Risks
This stock is High Risk based upon our quantitative model but assigning a
High Risk rating is not supported by other qualitative factors such as cold-

plate leadership and deep CSP penetration, and so a High Risk rating has not
been applied. Key downside risks to our investment thesis and target price
include: 1) slower adoption pace for liquid cooling adoption; 2) heightened
price competition; 3) lower-than-expected share in liquid cooling
components; and 4) emerging alternative cooling technologies.
Auras Technology
Company description
Auras Technology was founded in 1998 and focused on the design and

manufacturing of thermal modules for NB/PCs. It quickly became one of
Taiwan’s top two NB cooling component suppliers. Early products included
heatsinks, fins, heat pipes, and fans for NBs, PCs, and smartphones. As
device form factor evolved, the company invested in new technologies such
Prepared for Kevin Lu

### Page 12

Taiwan Electronic Components & Equipment
17 September 2026 Citi Research
12
as ultra-thin vapor chamber in the 2000s to address the thermal challenges
of increasingly compact consumer electronics. During the 2010s, Auras
expanded into graphic card and server cooling and was an early adopter of
liquid cooling technology. By 2012, the company had begun developing liquid
cooling component and was among the first Taiwanese firms to venture into
AI server liquid cooling.

Investment strategy
We rate Auras a Buy. Auras is emerging as a key liquid-cooling supplier as
hyperscalers expand deployment. The company has secured qualifications for
cold plates and manifolds, opening access to a wider slate of Nvidia and CSP
projects. Thailand-based production offers non-China capacity at a scale
aligned with hyperscaler sourcing plans, allowing Auras to compete more
effectively for next-generation products.
Valuation
We value Auras using a PE-based approach, reflecting its accelerating

earnings trajectory and rising share in liquid cooling market of AI servers. Our
TP of NT$1,800 is based on 20x 2027E EPS, which we believe is justified
given the company’s expanding server revenue base, deeper engagement
with CSP customers, and broader product portfolio across cold plates, CDMs,
and CDUs.
Risks
This stock is High Risk based upon our quantitative model, but assigning a
High Risk rating is not supported in our view by other qualitative factors such

as rapid RVL progress and Thailand expansion, and so a High Risk rating has
not been applied. Key downside risks to our investment thesis and target
price include: 1) slower adoption of liquid cooling; 2) heightened price
competition; 3) lower-than-expected share in liquid cooling components;
and 4) emerging alternative cooling technologies.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

Date: 2026-09-18
Pages: 8
Status: ok

### Page 1

Taiwan Information Technology

What’s new: We received an update from Jentech on 18 September. Its 
share price has been negatively impacted week to date by market talk 
concerning the adoption of removable lids in Vera Rubin and Rubin Ultra. 
However, we maintain our positive view on its ongoing product-upgrade 
roadmap and expect the ASP-upgrade trend to continue in the following 
years. We reaffirm our Buy (1) call (see our latest memo, Record-high 
monthly revenue for August; 3Q26 QTD revenue tracking ahead, on 7 
September 2026).

What’s the impact: Promising ASP upgrade trend. Due to rising thermal 
design power (TDP), we expect the ASP of Jentech’s removable lid for 
Vera Rubin or Rubin Ultra to be 5-6x higher vs. that of the current one-
piece lid. Following better-than-expected shipments during the ramp-up of 
Vera Rubin, we now forecast its 3Q26 revenue at TWD9.65bn (previously 
TWD9.26bn vs. Bloomberg consensus of TWD9.62bn) and 4Q26 revenue 
at TWD10.62bn (previously TWD10.20bn, vs. Bloomberg consensus of 
TWD10.32bn). We believe there could be some revenue upside potential, 
subject to the adoption of removable lids for Vera Rubin or Rubin Ultra. We 
now forecast an EPS CAGR of 86.1% over 2026-28E, from 78.8% 
previously, as we believe further product upgrades and a favourable 
product mix should continue to support improving profitability.

Bright outlook for GPU projects as well as ASIC projects. We believe 
Jentech has a more promising product roadmap for ASIC clients, with 
potential ASP upgrades from the current stiffener. After GPU clients adopt 
removable lids, it also could encourage its ASIC clients to adopt removable 
lids, translating to 15-20x ASP increase from here. We raise our 2026-28E 
EPS by 6-15%, mainly as a result of our more aggressive revenue and 
gross-/operating-margin assumptions.

What we recommend: We reiterate our Buy (1) call and raise our 12M TP 
to TWD9,420 (from TWD6,770), still based on a target PER of 73x (vs. its 
past-3-year PER range of 17-62x) applied to our 1-year forward EPS 
forecast, which is rolled over to 4Q26E-3Q27E (from 3Q26E-2Q27E). We 
believe our target valuation is fair, given Jentech’s strong earnings visibility 
and leading position in chip-level thermal solutions, which we believe 
warrant a rerating in addition to its strong moat and competitive landscape 
in the segment. Downside risks: weaker-than-expected global AI server 
demand and slower-than-expected thermal spec upgrades.

How we differ: Our 2026-28E EPS are 1-10% above Bloomberg 
consensus, likely as we are more aggressive in our revenue and gross-
/operating-margin assumptions.

18 September 2026

3Q26 preview: stronger-than-expected spec upgrades

➢ We maintain our positive view on Jentech’s product roadmap 
➢ Likely EPS upward revision trend in the following months 
➢ Reaffirming our Buy (1) call; raising 12-month TP to TWD9,420

Company profile 
Established in 1987, Jentech Precision Industrial is a leading global thermal-solutions and precision-
metal components maker that serves leading semiconductor and server vendors. As of 2025, its 
revenue comprised thermal heat spreaders (73%), lead frames (9%), electronic components (7%), 
communication connectors (1%) and others (10%).

ESG analysis

Update Date: 29 May 2026 
Source: Daiwa, Company

ESG risks
Risks Management Analyst comments
G
Executive/board
quality 1
The CEO and chairperson of Jentech is the same individual, Mr. Zhao Zongxin. We note that Mr.
Zhao has extensive long-term experience in senior management within the company and across
its subsidiaries, which is a positive sign from an executive perspective.
Capital management 1
Between 2021-25, Jentech has maintained a dividend payout ratio of around 60%, which we
consider reasonable for balancing shareholder returns with reinvestment needs. This consistent
approach reflects prudent capital management discipline and a stable financial policy.
Related party &
transaction 1
The company engages in transactions with subsidiaries primarily for normal operational
purposes, such as purchase of materials and components. The proportion of these costs to
overall COGS remains low, and no irregular or non-transparent transactions were identified.
E Supply chain
management 1
Jentech has a structured procurement process, including supplier evaluation, signature of
procurement contracts, and requirements for compliance with environmental and safety
regulations. The company also diversifies sourcing channels (major suppliers from Taiwan,
Japan, Europe, Korea, USA) and maintains stable supply relationships, with clear
communication protocols for prompt response to supplier issues. This reflects strong supply
chain transparency and robust quality control measures.
E Data security 1
The company has established an information security team, conducts annual internal control
audits, and implements procedures such as asset inventory, network security monitoring, virus
prevention systems, firewall management, and access rights control. Backup systems and
disaster recovery mechanisms are in place, allowing the company to restore information system
operations and minimize damage during major incidents or equipment failures.
Note: Management score represents a company's ability to manage/benefit from certain ESG topics. The scores range from 1 to 3, with 1 being the strongest.

### Page 1

Macquarie Equity Research
18 September 2026
Technology
Alchip Technologies
Growth acceleration under way
Key Points
• Alchip's 3nm AI ASIC project ramped in 2Q26 and has driven strong
HoH and YoY growth from 2H26.
• We believe the 3nm AI ASIC ramp-up and next-generation tape-out in
late-2026 are key catalysts for Alchip shares.
• While we do not forecast additional CSP projects, the company is
"highly confident" it can secure another major CSP customer.
Expect 100%+ sales CAGR in 2026/27
• We believe share-price upside could be driven by: 1) the successful
ramp of its key customer’s 3nm AI ASIC (shipments from June), 2)
success in winning the key customer’s next-generation projects (tape
out in late-2026), and 3) other key projects, including networking-related
projects that could help drive 2027 and beyond sales growth, along with
multiple ADAS projects (the first major project ramped up in 1Q26).
• We maintain our positive long-term view on ASIC industry growth,
driven by the continued outsourcing of IC design services to Asia,
supported by a large talent pool and lower costs, and by Alchip's strong
competitive position and track record. We are not concerned about
Alchip's key customer's agreements with other semiconductor peers.
We believe these agreements highlight the large, growing TAM for the
customer's AI ASIC and related ecosystem. We also note that Alchip's
largest customer has invested in Alchip stock twice.
• Company remains bullish through at least 2029: During its 2Q26
analyst meeting in August, the company reiterated that sales should be
"at least in line with AI ASIC industry growth through 2029." The company
also expressed confidence in 3nm AI ASIC sales from June 2026 and in
the successful tape-out of its next-generation AI ASIC project before
year-end.
Earnings changes: We raise our 2026E/2027E/2028E EPS rep by
9%/27%/20% to reflect the higher scale of AI ASIC projects.
Valuation: We raise our target price 4% to NT$6,784, based on a 26x 2028E
PER, from NT$6,542, based on a 30x 2028E PER. Our new multiple is back in
line with the historical average and to reflect high customer concentration.
Catalysts: Sustained revenue growth from June; successful tape-out of a
next-generation project in 2H26.
Investment Thesis and Recommendation
As a key AI beneficiary with a strong track record of successful leading-
edge project ramps, we continue to believe in Alchip's long-term growth
outlook and remain positive on AI ASIC industry growth. Link to prior
Alchip research.

### Page 2

Macquarie Equity Research Alchip Technologies
Key Risks to Investment Thesis
• Project ramp-up delays or failure to reach mass production,
resulting in lower-than-expected scale.
• Order reductions from key customers, including potential
impacts from US semiconductor regulations, leading to
sales or earnings misses.
• Failure to secure key customers' next-generation projects.
Company Description
Alchip is a IC design service companies that assists IC design

and system companies to complete chip designs. Their
revenues come in two main streams: 1) NRE (non-recurring
engineering) which is the service provided starting with the
back-end design of the semiconductor to tape out at foundry.
2) Turnkey occurs when Alchip assists customers in placing
wafer orders to foundries (TSMC) and delivering final wafers to
customers.

### Page 2

Taiwan Semiconductors
21 September 2026 Citi Research
2
TSMC: AI growth broadens beyond GPU/ ASIC  — TSMC remains central to nearly
every major AI hardware transition. The most important point is that its AI
opportunity is broader than the GPU/ASIC revenue definition investors typically
focus on. Networking silicon, AI CPUs, silicon photonics and advanced packaging
provide incremental growth vectors, while the underlying compute roadmap
continues migrating rapidly toward leading-edge nodes. We expect stronger 2027

growth for TSMC thanks to full-year contribution from 2nm, increased 3nm AI-
chip volumes and potential pricing increases, creating another powerful
combination of volume, mix and ASP expansion. In terms of competitive
landscape, we think Intel still needs substantial leading-edge capacity for its own
CPUs and appears constrained in its ability to simultaneously support internal
products and large external AI customers. In addition, Intel’s 14A ecosystem and

PDK/customer engagement process would require considerable qualification and
design-cycle time before translating into meaningful external production. For
critical AI products, customers also need predictable multiyear capacity
commitments; TSMC’s manufacturing scale and supply-chain coordination remain
important competitive advantages. Nevertheless, we see potential opportunities
for Intel and UMC’s collaboration at 12nm, that could support products such as

connectivity, display-driver or consumer-related chips, while its advanced
packaging technology could also win specialized programs. However, those
opportunities should be distinguished from a broad challenge to TSMC’s leading-
edge foundry position. Strategically, we think TSMC is becoming more selective
about where it deploys capital and engineering resources. We believe front-end
wafer manufacturing, SoIC and differentiated technologies such as silicon

photonics remain priorities, while more conventional back-end operations are
increasingly suitable for outsourcing. This suggests that continued AI growth can
benefit TSMC directly through leading-edge wafer revenue while simultaneously
creating substantial opportunities for OSAT partners.
TSMC outsourcing creates a structural opportunity for ASEH- Given the tight
supply for both advanced node wafer and CoWoS, we think leading-edge front-
end manufacturing generates the highest strategic value, and we believe TSMC has

an incentive to prioritize wafer fabrication and differentiated packaging
technologies such as SoIC while outsourcing larger portions of more back-end
processing. CoWoS capacity can continue expanding, but TSMC’s own back-end
investment intensity may eventually moderate as qualified OSAT partners assume
more steps. ASE/SPIL are already participating in substrate-related outsourced
work and should gain additional opportunities as the ecosystem matures. Other

Taiwanese packaging companies can also participate, while interposer production
itself could become more distributed across external partners. Importantly, ASEH
is not dependent solely on TSMC outsourcing. It is developing its own full-process
advanced-packaging capabilities, including FoCoS, providing a more direct route
to capture high-value AI packaging revenue. AMD is an important
customer/catalyst for ASEH, in our view, particularly as CPU and heterogeneous-

compute architectures require increasingly sophisticated packaging. ASEH’s
management’s expectation that leading-edge advanced-packaging revenue can
roughly double underscores the potential operating leverage. As chiplets, HBM,
silicon photonics and increasingly complex interconnects proliferate, packaging
content per device rises and the technical barriers to entry increase, potentially
supporting structurally better margins for ASEH.
CPO is emerging as the next major AI infrastructure transition - Co-packaged

optics (CPO) appears to be one of the clearest structural transitions in AI hardware
because it addresses two increasingly severe constraints simultaneously: data
transmission bandwidth and power consumption. We expect Nvidia should be the
initial catalyst, first through Spectrum-X CPO switches and subsequently
Prepared for Kevin Lu

### Page 3

Taiwan Semiconductors
21 September 2026 Citi Research
3
through CPO integration associated with next-generation NVLink scale-up
architectures and Rubin Ultra. Importantly, there are two different CPO adoption
timelines that are often confused. CPO embedded directly alongside GPU/compute
packages could remain two to three years away, but switch-level CPO is
considerably closer and should begin scaling earlier. Moving optical connectivity
closer to the switching silicon can materially reduce electrical I/O distance and

power while supporting higher aggregate bandwidth. During Semicon Taiwan in
early Sep, CPO coupling, optical alignment, fiber-array assembly and testing were
among the most prominent themes. TSMC is developing its COUPE silicon-
photonics/packaging platform, while a broader ecosystem is forming around
optical engines, lasers, fiber-array units (FAUs), receptacles, precision alignment
and test equipment. The most visible near-term bottlenecks appear to be external

laser sources and fiber/FAU capacity, helping explain aggressive expansion by
suppliers such as Lumentum and Corning. The transition could also redistribute
semiconductor supply-chain value as CPO moves more value into advanced
semiconductor packaging, silicon photonics, optical coupling and testing. We
believe Largan’s high precision automation capability will be able to catch CPO
opportunity particularly in the most challenging optical fiber array alignment

process.
Custom ASIC: MediaTek and GUC riding with Google - The Google TPU ecosystem
illustrates both the opportunity and the execution complexity of custom AI silicon.
We believe MediaTek’s role should increase substantially over coming generations,
MediaTek’ s target market share is 15–20% initially but we see more upside ahead.
With current TPU v8 generation, MediaTek’s responsibility is concentrated more
heavily in I/O, SerDes and wafer-handling-related activities; in the subsequent

generation, its scope expands toward portions of the compute implementation as
well. The SerDes configuration itself is also expected to increase, while advanced-
node compute content materially lifts MediaTek’s dollar value per device.
Consequently, revenue can grow much faster than TPU units or market share alone
would suggest. One execution risk is advanced packaging. A future
Google/MediaTek program is expected to utilize Intel’s EMIB-T technology, which is

less proven at very high volume than TSMC’s mature CoWoS ecosystem. Much of
the difficult integration work, however, is distributed across substrate suppliers
and OSAT partners. We think the initial yields and volumes could therefore be
constrained, but the program has strategic importance for Google, Intel and
MediaTek and is likely to proceed despite an early learning curve. And we believe its
existing TPU generations should also continue shipping during the transition,

cushioning the revenue impact. We believe Google’s broader engagement with
AMD and Marvell should not automatically be interpreted as additional TPU
suppliers, in our view, Marvell has important networking and storage relationships
with Google, while AMD opportunities appear more closely associated with CPUs.
More broadly, the ASIC ecosystem remains structurally more fragmented than
Nvidia’s platform. Google is gradually internalizing more silicon expertise, but it still

requires external design-service and implementation partners. We also see
substantial growth of Google’s CPU at GUC, which is fully COT model with back-
end only service.
AI systems and power: Hon Hai benefits from Rubin, while 800VDC adoption
should be gradual- At the system level, Hon Hai remains a major beneficiary of
Nvidia’s rack-scale transition. This year’s growth has been driven largely by higher
AI rack shipments, but next year adds a much higher ASP as the supply chain

transitions from GB300 toward Vera Rubin. Higher rack value means revenue and
profit can rise substantially even if unit growth moderates, provided margins
remain broadly stable. Beyond Nvidia, Hon Hai is also positioning itself to
manufacture custom-ASIC and hyperscaler systems, including CPU- and TPU-
Prepared for Kevin Lu

### Page 4

Taiwan Semiconductors
21 September 2026 Citi Research
4
related racks, which could begin contributing more meaningfully later next year.
Power architecture is another major debate, particularly around 800VDC. The
key distinction is that 800VDC is strategically attractive but not necessarily
mandatory for Rubin or even every Rubin Ultra deployment. Rack power rises
materially from the GB300 generation toward Rubin, requiring changes such as
sidecar power shelves and more sophisticated power distribution. New greenfield

AI data centers and neocloud deployments have stronger incentives to design
around 800VDC because they can optimize the entire facility for future high-
density racks. Existing facilities, however, can continue using alternative
architectures, making adoption gradual rather than immediate. We believe Delta
remains structurally well positioned in high-power data-center infrastructure, but
expectations around the speed of 800VDC adoption may be slower than expected.

The industry also faces a significant engineering learning curve as rack power
density rises, including thermal management and potential overheating issues.
Separately, shortages of power-management ICs and capacitors remain important
constraints regardless of whether a data center uses 800VDC. Analog and power-
semiconductor supply is supported by both AI-driven demand and relatively tight
capacity at IDM suppliers and specialty foundries such as UMC and VIS.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

Greater China Technology Hardware
Asia Pacific
Industry View In-Line
CCL –  Doosan announces
capacity expansion in Korea and
China
What’s new? According to Business Korea, Doosan (000150.KS, not covered)
announced a KRW970B CCL capacity expansion on Sep 17:
• KRW420B in Korea to add optical module CCL lines, and
• KRW550B in China to build a new plant for AI accelerator and network
switch CCL.
Spending is phased through 2028, with the new lines coming online sequentially

from 2H28.
Our thoughts:  Our checks suggest this investment could add ~2,000K sheets per
month of CCL capacity at Doosan, equivalent to ~2% of global CCL capacity in 2028,
on our estimates. We view the investment as further evidence of robust demand for
high-end CCL and do not believe it undermines our thesis of continued high-end CCL
scarcity (see our CCL initiation report). As such, we see a positive read-across for
EMC, TUC, and Shengyi. We remain OW on EMC and TUC, while maintaining our EW

communications with a subject company, public appearances
and trading securities held by a research analyst account.

Hon Precision (7769.TW)
21 September 2026 Citi Research
2
Hon Precision
Valuation
Our target price of NT$11,000 is based on a target PER multiple of 36x applied to the average of our 2027E/28E EPS estimates.
Our PER target of 35x is set at 1-std above its 1-year PER average, justified by its high share of the AI/HPC testing handler
market, which we estimate could support an earnings CAGR of 77% in 2025-28, higher than its 3-year CAGR at c40% in 2022-

25. Our estimated 77% earning CAGR is also higher than the +40% average (Bloomberg consensus) of its global testing
equipment peers. As its peers have been trading at  average  36x PER on 2027/28 consensus EPS in the past 1 year, we believe
Hon Precision deserves a further re-rating to our target PER of 36x.
Risks
Our quantitative risk rating system, which looks at historical share price volatility, rates Hon Precision High Risk. However, we
are not assigning a High Risk rating as we forecast an earnings CAGR of >75%, significantly stronger than the growth outlook

for its global peers. Also, we note its dominant position in AI/HPC handler market and expanding market TAM opportunity,
which support our constructive view over its growth outlook.
Key downside risks that could impede the shares from reaching our target price: 1) Global AI demand slowdown  driving weaker
capacity build for semiconductor equipment; 2) unexpected share losses at its major AI projects; 3) slower-than-expected
capacity ramp at its new facilities, or the company taking a long time to find/secure new sites; 4) slower-than-expected

development of its CPO business; 5) shorter-than-expected testing time leading to lower demand for its products; 6) weak
adoption of high-premium cold plate products; and 7) increasing competition from new entrants.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

考量 3Q26 動能仍佳、新產品效應，評等 Trading Buy 。  
投資建議 ：由於台灣、中國市場分別受惠於半導體封測、夾爪
類 /大型過濾器等訂單數量增加， 3Q26 氣立營收展望仍佳，加上
超音波流量感測器、靈巧手的長線潛在營收動能均可期，故群
益對氣立的投資建議為 Trading Buy 。  
2Q26 稅後淨利 0.45 億元， QoQ+1691.81% ：受惠於氣動元件出
貨暢旺， 2Q26 營收 4.92 億元， QoQ+21.19% ，毛利率則受惠於
產品組合優於 1Q26 而提高至 32.95% ，故營業利益增加至 0.36
億元， QoQ+333.28% ，此外，業外表現則因 0.19 億元處分子公
司利益而轉佳，稅後淨利 0.45 億元， QoQ+1691.81% 。  
3Q26 營收動能優於 2Q26 ：近期上海松江廠、台北泰山廠的產
能利用率分別為 80~85% 、接近 80%，觀察氣立在手訂單狀況，
3Q26 氣動元件營收展望仍佳 ， 浙江平湖廠產能利用率則自 3Q25
迄今均滿載，預估 3Q26 亦然，群益預估， 3Q26 氣立營收
QoQ+6.16% ，惟預估 4Q26 營收將因淡季效應而較 3Q26 減少。  
若就長線潛在營收動能而言，則以超音波流量感測器、靈巧手
較可期，其中，超音波流量感測器初期以液冷散熱、半導體廠
務為目標市場，目前已通過客戶認證，且自 2Q26 季末開始出
貨，後續亦再計畫拓展水資源、生技醫療、自動化設備等垂直
市場，此外，氣立亦將超音波流量感測器、電動球閥搭配成流
量感測模組，並預計自 2027 年開始出貨，若確成真，則對推升
氣立營收規模的助益程度將較大。  
氣立的靈巧手除原有的 3 指產品外，亦已推出 5 指產品，產品
線更形完整，初期鎖定的終端應用為工業機器人、協作機器人，
後續並計畫擴及人形機器人。若就有機會出貨的訂單來源而言，
首先，氣立現已送樣至台灣半導體大廠認證，最快 2027 年開始
出貨，其次，浙江平湖廠為中國系統業者代工人形機器人外殼
機構件，亦有機會成為靈巧手的訂單來源。

  企業 ESG 資訊揭露：  
就強化能源、水資源管理而言，氣立現階段主要動作有三， (1) 製程多採用氣
動或電動等未使用直接排放大量溫室氣體之設備，且在採購相關設備初即
會選擇具有變頻節能功能之設備， (2) 氣立泰山廠區已全面改採 LED 照明設
備並汰換老舊生產設備，以降低用電度數， (3) 氣立泰山廠區透過水塔維修
及管線改善以降低用水度數。  
就供應鏈管理而言，氣立已建立完善的供應商稽核及評鑑制度，且每年均會
針對台灣供應商進行實地評鑑，以確保供應商在產品、品質、技術、環安衛
等項目符合法規及氣立本身的要求，且未來氣立亦持續朝強化永續供應鏈
的方向前進。  
受惠於氣動元件需求增溫、處分子公司利益， 2Q26 稅後淨利 0.45 億元，
QoQ+1691.81% ：  
氣立為氣動元件廠，上市同業為亞德客 -KY(1590 TT) ，由於氣立產能不及亞
德客 -KY，成本控制、零組件採購能力亦相對遜色，不過，氣立乃提升產品
價格競爭力並積極拓展少量多樣的利基型產品市場 (相關產品通常原由日、
德同業供應，氣立價格競爭力相對較佳，至於亞德客 -KY 爭取訂單的意願則
因訂單數量較小而偏低 )，故仍得以持續擴大出貨規模。  
氣立已在台北泰山、上海松江、浙江平湖 (以壓鑄等上游製程為主，產品毛
利率相對較低 )、泰國等 4 地設廠，產品包括氣缸、電磁閥、機械夾爪、真
空處理元件等，此外，亦推出電控產品。而氣立產品的終端應用領域涵蓋電
子、通用機械、汽車、服裝、機床、包裝機械、焊接設備、化工機械等，其
中，電子業近幾年營收比重均居冠，達 25~35% ，相關消費性電子產品終端
市場需求榮枯為氣立營運狀況的重要觀察指標；通用機械業近幾年營收比
重為 10~15% ，為氣立穩定的訂單來源，至於其餘垂直市場近幾年的營收比
重則均低於 5%。  
氣立產品的主要銷售地區為中國、台灣，近幾年營收比重分別為 65~90% 、
10~20% ，換言之，中國製造業景氣為影響氣立出貨表現影響甚鉅。氣立除
爭取代工訂單外，亦經營 CHELIC 自有品牌，由於持續在中國佈建自身行銷
通路有成，目前在當地設置的辦事處、駐在點超過 40 個，透過經銷商出貨
的營收比重近幾年已降低至 15~25% ，群益認為，在中國佈建通路為氣立得
以在當地鞏固客源並深耕市場的關鍵。  
2Q26 營收 4.92 億元， QoQ+21.19% ，動能來自氣動元件，原因有三， (1) 台
北泰山廠接獲半導體封測相關專案訂單， (2) 上海松江廠夾爪類、大型過濾
器等產品出貨暢旺，其中，夾爪類產品 1H26 營收 YoY 超過 20% ；大型過
濾器 1H26 營收 YoY 超過 15% ， (3) 泰國廠開始貢獻營收 (1H26 營收比重為
2~3%) ，毛利率則受惠於產品組合優於 1Q26 而提高至 32.95%(1Q26 為
30.13%) ，故營業利益增加至 0.36 億元， QoQ+333.28% ，此外，業外表現則
因 0.19 億元處分子公司利益而轉佳，稅後淨利 0.45 億元， QoQ+1691.81% 。
3Q26 營收動能優於 2Q26，長線潛在動能則以超音波流量感測器、靈巧手較
可期：  
近期上海松江廠、台北泰山廠的產能利用率分別為 80~85% 、接近 80% ，觀

3 群益投顧 
察氣立在手訂單狀況， 3Q26 氣動元件營收展望仍佳，浙江平湖廠產能利用
率則自 3Q25 迄今均滿載，預估 3Q26 亦然，群益預估， 3Q26 氣立營收
QoQ+6.16% ，惟預估 4Q26 營收將因淡季效應而較 3Q26 減少。  
若就長線潛在營收動能而言，則以超音波流量感測器、靈巧手較可期，其中，
超音波流量感測器初期以液冷散熱、半導體廠務為目標市場，目前已通過客
戶認證，且自 2Q26 季末開始出貨，後續亦再計畫拓展水資源、生技醫療、
自動化設備等垂直市場，此外，氣立亦將超音波流量感測器、電動球閥搭配
成流量感測模組，並預計自 2027 年開始出貨，若確成真，則對推升氣立營
收規模的助益程度將較大。  
氣立的靈巧手除原有的 3 指產品外，亦已推出 5 指產品，產品線更形完整，
初期鎖定的終端應用為工業機器人、協作機器人，後續並計畫擴及人形機器
人。若就有機會出貨的訂單來源而言，首先，氣立現已送樣至台灣半導體大
廠認證，最快 2027 年開始出貨，其次，浙江平湖廠為中國系統業者代工人
形機器人外殼機構件，亦有機會成為靈巧手的訂單來源。  
考量 3Q26 動能仍佳、新產品效應，群益對氣立的投資建議為 Trading Buy ：
由於台灣、中國市場分別受惠於半導體封測、夾爪類 /大型過濾器等訂單數
量增加， 3Q26 氣立營收展望仍佳，加上超音波流量感測器、靈巧手的長線
潛在營收動能均可期，故群益對氣立的投資建議為 Trading Buy 。

研 究  報 告                
達明(4585.TT) 
產業：電子–其他電子 
協作機器人與 AI 實體化需求快速成⻑，享技術優勢與集團奧援 
 投資評價與建議 
業界唯⼀原⽣標配AI視覺，成⻑速度可望優於產業：達明扮演廣達集團(2382)
端側實體AI與工業自動化末端執行的關鍵戰略角色，隨著製造業由 「大規模標
準化」轉向「少樣多樣柔性⽣產」，協作機器⼈的需求快速成⻑，達明的產品
是業界唯⼀原⽣標配AI視覺，成⻑速度可望優於產業，惟目前評價已在上緣。 
 重點評論分析 
2Q26稅前淨利季增81%，2H營運優於1H： 2Q26營收5.1億元季增6%(年增
29%)，毛利率因高毛利率產品比重提升而由1Q26的49.9%增加至52.3%，營
業外收入中包含⼈形機器⼈專案的政府補助金約新台幣3,000萬元，稅前淨利
1.4億元季增81%，EPS 1.18元，1H26EPS 1.83元；客戶擴產、AI伺服器產能
建置、大負載搬運自動化需求帶動下，2H26營運優於1H26。 
半導體 、 伺服器及AI等產業具優勢 ， 高階產品逐步拉高將有助於毛利率的提升 ：
AI推升工業自動化的需求，達明將把握半導體、伺服器及AI等產業的趨勢及優
勢，機器⼈市場的年複合成⻑率約20％～30％，2026~2028年的營收成⻑率
均可優於產業平均；標準協作機器⼈手臂產品比重已降至50%以下，高階產品
如AI視覺與複合式機器⼈及⼈形機器⼈與實體AI比重將逐年拉高，將有助於毛
利率的提升。 
 投資風險 
差異化優勢減退、同業殺價競爭。

AI佈局採人形機器人與既有機械手臂 「雙引擎」 策略：在AI布局方面，則採⼈形機器⼈與既有機械手臂 「雙引擎」 策略，
⼀方面持續開發⼈形機器⼈，另⼀方面則把相同的AI訓練與學習架構，移植到既有的單臂及雙臂機器⼈，加速實體AI的

學習，希望逐步讓⼈形機器⼈具備執行⼀般工作的能⼒，⼈形機器⼈未來真正落地，將是採取混和方式，整合不同功能
模組，達明⻑期深耕工業自動化，具備工業應用知識，加上既有機械手臂的AI及控制技術，將是切入⼈形機器⼈的主要
競爭優勢；⼈形機器⼈要形成更大市場價值可能仍需要時間，但單臂、雙臂以及結合AMR的AI應用，已經存在立即性的

緊密，將是未來掌握實體AI及工業自動化成⻑機會的重要基礎；達明的技術差異化在於內建視覺及AI，並採Windows-

汽車與金屬加工主要用於汽車零部件 、 金屬加工 、 螺絲鎖附 、 拋光及焊接等自動化產線 ； 新興與⺠⽣領域積極拓展紡織 、

公司以及廣達、鴻海(2317)等電子代工龍頭。 
廣達集團旗下實體AI的重要推手：達明前身為廣明光電（6188）內部的自動化事業部，於2015年獨立分割成立，現為
廣達集團旗下的重要孫公司(廣達持有廣明約30%的股權，廣明持有達明78%的股權)，在廣達集團的分工定位中，廣達
主攻 AI 伺服器與大型雲端運算硬體，廣明聚焦儲存與系統整合，而達明則承擔端側實體AI與工業自動化末端執行的關
鍵戰略角色；達明具備極高的研發密集度，研發工程師佔比近40%，涵蓋軟體演算法、機器視覺、運動控制及 AI 深度

在產能與資源配置上，達明堅持台灣研發製造模式，主要⽣產廠區集中於桃園龜山廠區，產品通過嚴格的SEMI S2半導
體安全認證；未來達明計畫以桃園為核⼼進行模組化產能擴張，並配合集團在墨⻄哥、越南及泰國的海外製造基地，延
伸部署系統整合的在地服務能⼒。 
台灣製造、外銷覆蓋率高，搭配集團全球化⽣產基地具優勢：外銷比重超過80%，業務遍及歐美亞澳四大洲，銷售覆蓋

人形機器人的結構與零組件

資料來源 : IEK、 玉山投顧整理、繪製  
AI模型讓機器人可持續學習優化 ：機器⼈智能可分為三個決策層 、 執行層及感知層三個主要層級 ， 決策層負責環境理解 、
任務規劃與行為決策；執行層由機器⼈本體與運動控制系統組成，包括伺服馬達、減速機、關節模組與控制器，負責把 
AI 的決策轉換成具體動作；感知層負責蒐集環境資訊，常見設備有RGB或RGB-D攝影機、雷射測距儀、⼒矩與觸覺感
測器，以及慣性量測單元，透過多模態感測資訊融合，系統才能對環境與物件有更精準的理解；AI模型讓機器⼈可持續
學習優化 ， 隨著⼈形機器⼈與雙臂操作機器⼈快速發展 ， 機構設計也愈來愈接近⼈類 ， 如多自由度關節 、 靈巧手等設計 ，
讓機器⼈能在既有的⼈類工作環境中執行更複雜的任務。 
機器人智能系統主要層級包括決策層、執行層與感知層

控制器相當於機器人的大腦，AI時代更形重要：控制器的主要功能包括運動控制(計算多軸反向運動學，實現精準定位與
軌跡追蹤)、信號傳遞(將邏輯決策轉為電氣信號傳給驅動器與馬達)、安全防護(緊急停止與安全監控保護⼈員與設備)與
系統整合(連接視覺、⼒覺感測器以及工廠聯網通訊) ，AI時代將更形重要。 
AI時代控制器更形重要

資料來源 : 新代法說會簡報 
人機協作為目前工廠新典型，未來將走向智慧化：⼈機協作是指⼈類與⼈工智慧、機器⼈或自動化系統共同工作、互補
優勢以達成任務的模式，它透過機器處理大量數據與重複性工作，結合⼈類的創造⼒、同理⼼與終端決策，實現效率與
價值的最大化；核⼼優勢與分工在⼈機協作的模式下，⼈類與機器各司其職，發揮最強效能，機器擅⻑資料快速運算、
例行程序自動化、預測分析與24小時監控，而⼈類擅⻑戰略方向決策、複雜情境判斷、創意發想以及⼈際同理⼼溝通；
⼈機協作的共同效益為大幅降低⼈⼒閒置、提升組織⽣產⼒，並協助員工從低技術工作轉型為高附加價值工作，⼈機協
作為目前工廠新典型，但未來將走向智慧化，智慧化機器⼈結合了AI、先進感測器與精密控制系統，能自主感知周遭環
境、進行即時資料分析、做出決策，並執行原本需要⼈類智慧與物理動作才能完成的複雜任務，將AI實體化，其核⼼技
術與特點在於將大腦演算法與實體機械結合，讓機器⼈具備空間理解與動態適應能⼒，並具有高精度感測與視覺，可透
過3D深度相機、光達與扭⼒感測器，做到精準避障與靈敏控制，由於具有模組化關節與驅動，透過高度整合馬達、驅動
器與通訊介面，提升扭⼒密度與即時反應速度；智慧化機器⼈主要應用領域智慧製造包括彈性產線、自動化組裝、設備
巡檢與物料搬運；醫療與照護方面如支援手術輔助、醫療物流與高齡化社會的照護陪伴；也能應用於特殊與極端環境，
如進入災害現場、地下空間或危險區域進行偵察與救援。

協作型機器人市場至2034年的年均複合成⻑率為35%：協作型機器⼈ （Cobot） 是⼀種專為與⼈類在共同工作空間內安
全協作而設計的機器⼈，與傳統工業機器⼈不同，其設計核⼼不是「最大化速度與⼒量」，而是「讓機器能夠安全地在
⼈的旁邊工作」，協作型機器⼈的概念最早在 1990 年 代由學術界提出，2008年丹麥Universal Robots推出第⼀款 商
業化Cobot協作型機器⼈後，這個品類才真正進入工業應用視野。此後十餘年間，隨著感測技術、控制演算法與製造成
本的成熟，協作型機器⼈快速普及，從歐美大廠擴展到亞洲製造業的中小型工廠。依據Precedence Research預估，協
作型機器⼈市場2025年為56億美元，2034年將可增加至713億美元，年均複合成⻑率為35%。 
機器人走向通用化、智能化、自主化

維持評等  
增加持股(Overweight) 
訂單需求持續強勁 ， 加快擴產速度  
⚫ 預期 2026 下半 年營收將逐季墊高  
⚫ 中國大陸強 勁成長， 2026 下半年轉 由日本驅動成長  
⚫ 產能持續擴 充 ，2026 年底 產能將 提升至 8,400 萬片  
預期 2026 下半年營收將逐季墊高 ：望隼 2Q26 營運表現強勁， 營收
12.0 億元 (QoQ+ 16%、YoY+37%)；毛利率 43.5%，較去年同期提升 2
個百分點，主要受惠稼動率滿載產生的規模經濟，以及製程持續優
化；帶動 營業利益率 提升至 31%，稅後淨利 2.8 億元 (YoY+86%)、EPS 
4.7 3 元。 展望 2026 下半年， 公司表示日本及中國大陸客戶訂單持續
回流，加上節慶備貨需求、矽水膠產品開始明顯 放量 ，以及新產能逐
步開出，營收有望逐季成長；毛利率則有望受惠稼動率持續高檔 及產
品組合優化 ，持穩於上半年的高水準 42~43% 。 
中國大陸強勁成長， 2026 下半年 由日本接棒 ：區域營運方面，中國大
陸佔比 54% 為主要營收來源 ，受惠定位彩片 引發的熱潮 ，前 7 月營收
YoY+55% 。日本市場佔比 35% ，雖因產能優先支援中國而 YoY-9%，
但隨著下半年產能轉向全力供應日本，預期業績將迎來強勁成長。台
灣市場受惠於 通路策略與 產品口碑發酵，營收 YoY+148% 。美國市場
則為長線佈局重點，公司持續積極推廣矽水膠產品，預計到 2027 年
下半年將有 較顯著客戶進 展，擴大整體海外市場。 公司 未來將結合多
焦、散光、抗藍光 等功能 於矽水膠 材質，持續 以差異化產品 擴大市佔 。 
產能持續擴充 ，2026 年底將來到 8,400 萬片 ：因應持續湧現的市場訂
單，望隼積極展開產能擴充計畫 。目前月產能近 7,000 萬片，稼動率
維持在高檔；並持續進行擴產工作， 預計至 2026 年底月產能將提升
至 8,400 萬片。 2027 年則以 1 億片為目標， 但具體擴產時間點仍會觀
察訂單和需求來決定 。產品組合 部分 ，2Q26 美瞳片佔比來到 58% ，
市 場對美 瞳片 需求持 續強 勁；矽 水膠 佔比 約 2%，已 開始出 貨日本 市
場，預期 2026 下半年在配合日本客戶新產品的上市，出貨量將進一
步放大，帶動矽水膠 全年營收佔比至 3~5% 。 
評價：以未來四季 預估 EPS 計算，給予 近年本益比區間中 緣 12.5 倍，
目標價 235 元，維持增加持股評等。 風險因子 ：矽水膠推廣不如預期 、
中國市場消費景氣變化、 匯率波動 。

目標價調整至 134 元(10X*2027EPS 13.40 元)。 惟現階段股價評價仍屬相對低檔 ，
隨非中國地區占比提升與歐洲併購綜效逐步顯現， 中長期配置價值仍在， 建議可逢
低佈局，故維持買進建議。

### Page 2

2

胡連為台灣端子大廠：胡連精密股份有限公司成立於 1977 年，為台灣車用連接器
製造商，主要生產汽車端子、塑膠盒及模具等產品為主， 2Q26 產品組合為塑件
35.4%、端子 28.4%、電源配線盒(保險絲盒) 11.6%、線束 10.7%、板端件 6.1%、
高頻 5.1%、 高壓0.7%等 。 商業模式為將原物料(塑膠 、 銅等)製成端子或連接器後 ，
供貨給下游線束或模組廠，再透過線束或模組廠交貨給汽車廠商。2Q26 地區域銷
售比重：中國76%、台灣 4.7%、越南 2.7%、印尼 2.3%、歐洲 3.3%、美洲 5.1%、
亞太 5.8%。中國客戶多為 OEM 車廠，主要為中國自有品牌車廠，2Q26 比重為
吉利 11.3%、比亞迪 7.9%、長安 4.6%、Lear 3.9%、奇瑞 3%、五菱 1.1%。 
即將迎來中國市場旺季 ； 中期中國自主品牌重心轉向海外 ， 胡連藉多地產能卡位在
地化供應：7-8 月中國內需車市銷量偏弱，但受惠出口市場表現相對支撐，且胡連
主要客戶表現優於產業平均，推升胡連 7-8 月營收年增逾三成，預估 9-10 月營收
逐月成長，惟 4Q26 受基期墊高影響，年增率預期收斂至個位數。 
在中國內需疲軟的背景下， 中國自主品牌車廠未來重心逐步轉向海外， 包含海外當
地設廠 ， 胡連有望透過越南 、 印尼等既有產能 ， 甚至歐洲新併購機會取得海外產能 ，
提供在地化供應服務， 快速反應當地需求， 此為胡連中長期評價重新評估非中國地
區貢獻度的重要觀察指標。 
非中國地區(東南亞 、 歐洲等)訂單加速放量 、 歐洲新併購機會 ， 多元廠區分散風險 ：
(1) 胡連為比亞迪東南亞擴張戰略下的核心在地受惠者，在印尼取得比亞迪五款車
型的 PCB 保險絲盒訂單，隨比亞迪印尼廠產能爬坡，胡連營收認列高峰預計集中
於 2027~2028 年。(2) 因應客戶分散地緣風險需求，胡連於 2027 年擴大越南供
貨連接器產品予美系電動車客戶 ， 成長幅度上看50%以上 。(3) 歐洲現有客戶以比
雅久及 Stellantis 成長較顯著，未來加入新併購公司之業務，有望拓展更多客戶及
產品。(4) BMW 亞洲區原無連接器供應商(原由 TE 供貨)，今年胡連已切入一個新
料號，具備後續放量空間。綜合以上，預期 2027 年非中國地區占比將由 2026 年
約 20%提升至 25~30%(中國占比則由 80%降至 70~75%)。 
歐洲併購案為切入法拉利供應鏈的關鍵一步 ：胡連正評估收購兩家義大利公司， 其
一為高階車廠線束前端設計合格供應商， 具快速打樣能力； 胡連本身具連接器與線
束產能，可與其形成「連接器＋線束」 綜效供應，協助其在法拉利等高階車廠之滲
透率提升。其二聚焦農耕機特用市場，仍在價格議定階段，進度較慢。超跑相關標
的預計 10 月完成交割，2027 年可望完整貢獻全年營收；今明兩年財測目前均未
納入併購貢獻，故後續營收有上修空間；另外，合併後整體營業費用率預期將微幅
上升，因歐洲公司費用結構高於胡連本身水準。 
原物料成本壓力延續至 3Q26，毛利率預期低於 30%；展望 2027 年切入更多模
組化、智能化產品供應，胡連高附加價值產品比重持續提升：3Q26 銅價大漲，使
得實際銅成本季增 3%； 塑料成本也持續增長 ， 目前價格已較開戰前水準高約5%，
故預期 3Q26 將受原物料價格影響較大，毛利率將與 2Q26 相當；展望 4Q26 伴
隨營收規模放大，毛利率有機會重新靠近 30%。 
研究處估算 2026 年胡連新產品，如高頻、高壓、保險絲盒等將貢獻9~10 億元(原
預估 7~8 億元)， 隨著新產品陸續放量 ， 明後年量會最大 ， 新產品毛利率會比較高 ，
且胡連一直積極從一般低壓線束、連接器，轉向區域化、模組化的電線管理產品發
展，預計將先切入特殊車輛之車燈域控制、座椅域控制器等，隨著總成件產品比重
增加，也有助於均價及利潤率之提升，有望逐步淡化原物料上漲對毛利帶來的影
響。

營運現況與分析

之餘，非中國地區(東南亞、歐洲)訂單占比加速提升，且積極從一般低壓連接器轉
向區域化、模組化產品，有助於產品組合優化；另外，歐洲併購案有望切入法拉利
等高階超跑供應鏈，長線出貨結構更趨多元化，降低對單一市場之依賴。 
考量胡連 3Q26 原物料成本壓力延續、毛利率預期低於 30%，加上歐洲併購案交
割時程與合併後費用率仍有不確定性，評價上採較保守之本益比假設，以2027 年
EPS 13.40 元進行評價，本益比由 11X 下修至 10X，目標價調整至 134 元
(10X*2027EPS 13.40 元)。惟現階段股價評價仍屬相對低檔，隨非中國地區占比提
升與歐洲併購綜效逐步顯現，中長期配置價值仍在，建議可逢低佈局，故維持買進
建議。

關產品的比重，能有效改善產品組合及獲利能力，雖然晶圓代工及封測
可能再調漲價格，但 48V BLDC total solution 滲透率持續提升，投研部
認為應用於伺服器的功率元件或晶片控制模組，轉嫁能力佳，能彌補消
費性電子的衰退。

高趨勢，預估 3Q26 營收 7.44 億元，QoQ+14.10%，YoY+109.71%，

公司簡介 
廣閎科技成立於 2007 年，是台灣功率元件與類比IC 設計公司，核心產品包括Power 
MOSFET 功率元件、BLDC Motor Driver 無刷直流馬達驅動系統、SoC 散熱風扇驅動
IC，提供低碳、低耗能的高能源效率產品，從 IC 到電機/電池/電源管理創新系統設計
方案。Power MOSFET 功率元件營收比重約 70%，SoC 散熱風扇驅動 IC 及 BLDC 
Motor Driver 無刷直流馬達驅動系統約佔 30%。就產品應用層面來看，2Q26 工控車
用佔 33%，伺服器相關佔 47%，消費性電子佔 20%。

伺服器應用佔比持續上升，2Q26 EPS 2.21 元，創歷史新高 
廣閎科 2Q26 營收 6.52 億元，QoQ+26.76%，YoY+102.24%，稅後淨利 1.0 億元，
QoQ+89.63%，YoY 轉虧為盈，EPS 2.21 元。工控車用及消費性電子應用領域動能下
滑，但伺服器相關功率元件需求強勁，廣閎科在伺服器相關應用營收季成長 138%，
產品毛利率相對高，且在漲價帶動下，毛利率上升至 32.3%，季增 3.57 百分點。 
聚焦伺服器領域功率元件及控制模組，趨勢向上 
展望未來，消費性電子受晶圓代工、封測及零組件漲價影響，消費動能疲弱；工控及
車用領域持平；AI 伺服器對功率元件需求則呈現強勁成長。在目前晶圓代工及封裝產
能滿載情況下，廣閎科透過產能調配，優化其產品組合及獲利能力。目前伺服器領域
佔廣閎科營收比重約 47%，其中應用於電源供應器相關約佔 17%，備援電池(BBU)約
佔 10%，散熱風扇控制模組佔 10%。 
(1) 電源供應器中壓 MOSFET，台廠利基所在 
在 AI 伺服器的電源供應器領域，前端高壓功率元件、主板上低壓的 DrMOS，仍
由歐美 IDM 廠主導 ， 台廠的利基點聚焦在中壓功率產品 。 目前廣閎科約有17%營
收 ， 來自AI 伺服器電源供應器二次側 、 及54V 轉 12V DC-DC 模組的中壓 MOSFET
產品 。 在AI 伺服器供應鏈中 ， 高壓功率元件與核心主板供電的低壓大電流DrMOS 
具備極高的技術壁壘，利潤佳， IDM 巨頭將產能聚焦於高壓第三代半導體以及
GPU 核心供電的低壓 DrMOS/SPS 晶片。 在HVDC 架構下 ，電源進入機櫃後 ，需
經過多級降壓 ，需使用 80V–100V 的 MOSFET 進行同步整流與開關控制， 提供系
統安全防護與電路隔離的 Hot-Swap MOSFET。

(2) 48V BLDC Motor Driver 滲透率持續拉升 
在 AI 伺服器散熱區塊 ， 廣閎科主要提供12V SoC 散熱風扇晶片 、48V BLDC Motor 
Driver 無刷直流馬達驅動控制模組，兩者佔營收比重約 10%，隨著 AI 伺服器運
算力大幅拉升，過大的電流常引發嚴重的電阻熱損耗，為了達成高效節能並優化
散熱，AI 運算中心大舉推進 48V 供電變革，高電壓環境對系統耐壓限制極高，使
得散熱驅動技術被迫轉型，不再採用高度微縮的 12V SoC 整合晶片，轉而全面導
入結合高壓驅動 IC 與分離式大電流功率元件的 48V 高規馬達控制模組 ， 目前48V 
BLDC Motor Driver 營收佔比已超過 12V SoC，廣閎科憑藉著過往在白色家電領
域所積累的 BLDC 馬達驅動與功率元件開發經驗，成功切入伺服器 48V BLDC 領
域，其將 MCU、驅動 IC 與 MOSFET 預先整合於單一驅動模組板出貨，提供隨插
即用的一站式方案，免除散熱大廠硬體電路調校與訊號匹配，能縮短 AI 伺服器供
應鏈的開案時程，協助客戶快速通過嚴格的系統驗證。 
48V BLDC Motor Driver 相較於 12 V SoC ，需搭載 6 顆獨立的高壓低阻抗  
MOSFET，單價較對 12V 高，且在 48V 散熱模組的供電前端，必須搭配一組負責
熱插拔控制與電路保護的 MOSFET，廣閎科能透過 48CV BLDC Motor Driver 的
供貨優勢，能順勢搶食前端 Hot Swap MOSFET 市場。

(3) BBU 搭載率提升 
伴隨 AI 資料中心功耗上升，BBU（備援電池模組）已躍升為伺服器機櫃的剛性需
求，2026 年是 OCP ORV3 標準大舉鋪貨的黃金交叉期，微軟、Meta、Google 
等大廠紛紛跟進將 BBU 列為「標準配備」 ，為了支撐極高功耗，單個BBU 功率從
3kW 升級到 5.5kW 甚至 8kW，在維持 50V/54V 架構不變下，BBU 功率上升，
電流變大，必須透過多相交錯拓撲與 MOSFET 並聯分流來壓低熱損耗，MOSFET
用量變多。

伺服器領域產品轉嫁能力強，2026 下半年營運逐季走高 
廣閎科 8 月營收 2.51 億元，MoM+3.61%，YoY+114.20%，目前受限晶圓代工、下
游封裝產能，營運動能增長的驅動力，來自投片產品線的調整及價格的調漲，廣閎科
透過降低消費性產品的投片，提高伺服器相關產品的比重，能有效改善產品組合及獲
利能力，雖然晶圓代工及封測可能再調漲價格，但48V BLDC total solution 滲透率持
續提升，投研部認為應用於伺服器的功率元件或晶片控制模組，轉嫁能力佳，能彌補
消費性電子的衰退。整體而言，廣閎科憑藉著在控制模組的整合能力，加上中壓功率
元件市場的台廠利基，公司在 AI 伺服器領域的成長毛利率及獲利能力仍具有提升空
間 ， 獲利趨勢不變 。 投研部預估廣閎科2H26 營運仍將呈現緩步走高趨勢 ， 預估3Q26
營收 7.44 億元 ，QoQ+14.10%，YoY+109.71%， 稅後淨利1.19 億元 ，QoQ+19.09%，
YoY+316.35%，EPS 2.59 元。 
預估廣閎科 2027 年 EPS 11.13 元，建議買進，目標價 233 元 
投研部預估廣閎科 2026 年營收 26.68 億元 ，YoY+88.71%， 稅後淨利3.95 億元 ，YoY
轉虧為盈 ，EPS 8.69 元 ； 預估2027 年營收 30.38 億元 ，YoY+13.86%， 稅後淨利5.09
億元，YoY+28.81%，EPS 11.13 元。以 2027 年 EPS 評價，目前廣閎科 PE 16X，位
於 PE 區間 10X~40X 中下緣位置，考量 AI 伺服器領域成長動能佳，首次評等給予買
進投資建議，目標價 233 元(2027F P21X)。

研 究  報 告                
漢測(7856.TT) 
產業：半導體 
晶圓測試多年布局經驗有利其設備業務拓展，有利今明年營收顯著成⻑ 
 投資評價與建議 
考量漢測於晶圓測試領域可提供多項服務，彰顯其為AI趨勢成⻑下之主要
受惠廠商之⼀；另基於公司和ficonTEC合作關係使其跨入CPO測試領域有
利評價維持高檔。故認為公司評價可參考同業合理區間之上緣。 
 重點評論分析 
公司於晶圓測試階段廣泛布局：憑藉與日本設備廠之多年合作，使公司針對晶
圓針測機具有豐富之裝機、改機經驗，於晶圓測試階段提供高度客製化的解決
方案，而該領域相關設備亦為公司目前主要營收來源；另探針卡業務則因基期
較低故看好今明年成⻑動能顯著。 
未來聚焦四大成⻑動能：展望後市，公司四大布局包含：(1)因應晶圓測試重要
性提升，漢測提供之高功率散熱模組可提升測試散熱效率，避免探針卡燒針故
可改善晶圓測試穩定性 ； (2)觀察主要大廠如台積電 、 日月光均持續擴充先進封
裝產能，顯示公司回焊設備瞄準之先進封裝市場成⻑空間龐大；(3)因應高速
DRAM測試對於socket規格要求提升，將使得現行之Rubber socket面臨物理
限制 ， 故公司將於台南Membrane探針卡廠區進行高速socket開發 ， 預計1H27
送樣；(4)CPO測試領域中，公司布局insertion 1~3階段，其中Insertion 2和3
則與ficonTEC合作，且與ficonTEC Insertion2合作範圍已大致底定，包含從事
OEM/ODM及後續裝機與售後服務。 
 投資風險 
CPO量產時間延後、探針卡業務進展不如預期。

### Page 2

| 公司簡介
漢測成立於2004年9月，營運初期主要代理DRAM測試機和SLT測試設備，惟營運表現不理想使得公司持續推動轉
型調整；2016年漢測導入⺟集團漢⺠擅⻑之半導體⼯程幅度能⼒，聚焦晶圓測試服務並成立測試⼯程團隊，朝向
晶圓針測機的「裝機、移機、維修」技術服務轉型，順利於當年度轉虧為盈；2020年公司啟動第二波轉型，跨入
探針卡與清潔材料市場，並與日本探針卡大廠MJC展開探針卡技術合作。營運據點方面，公司總部位於新竹，並
於台南設有薄膜式探針卡製造中⼼；海外布局中，公司於中國蘇州、⾺來⻄亞、新加坡與美國設立⼦公司，另於
日本東京、熊本成立辦公室與維護中⼼。
目前公司產品布局橫跨半導體中下游，包含CP階段所需之探針卡及相關設備，先進封裝所需之電⼦束檢測設備、
回焊設備，及下游所需之DRAM SLT，而公司產品組合包含客製化產品及代理設備、探針卡與清潔材料、⼯程服
務(如機台安裝保養、移機改機)等。
圖表1：漢測產品布局
資料來源：漢測(2026/09)
客製化產品及代理設備為公司比重最高之產品別，目前已量產產品逾20多種，受益於累積多年的晶圓測試服務經

驗和日系半導體設備廠之合作關係，公司於晶圓測試階段提供多項客製化(配套)設備，包含自動化檢測設備(如白
光干涉光學檢測系統)、精密熱控與監測系統(如熱載測試系統)、製程優化設備與耗材(如雷射清針機、感測監控系
統)，可用於提升晶圓測試階段之測試穩定性、可靠性，並主要跟隨晶圓針測機市場規模成⻑；另公司開發驗證產
品則包含雷射清針機、回焊設備。
探針卡產品中，則包含薄膜式探針卡(Membrane)、懸臂式探針卡(Cantilever)、垂直探針卡(Vertical)，以及探針
卡清潔材料，其中公司為全台唯⼀具備薄膜式探針卡自主研發、製造及整卡解決方案能⼒的廠商，公司薄膜式探
針卡應用於5G/6G、RF高頻晶片及濾波器等領域，目前則朝向高速領域(如矽光⼦轉阻放大器(TIA))發展以搶攻矽
光⼦商機；懸臂式探針卡則聚焦於LCD Driver；垂直式探針卡則包含Cobra探針卡及MEMS探針卡，其中前者主
要應用於IPC、IPD，後者公司則正與MJC合作開發中。
| 產  業  趨  勢
Gartner預估今年全球半導體市場營收有望年增92.2%至1.56兆美元，且於今年突破1兆美元後，有望於2029年達

2兆美元，2025~2029年CAGR達25.9%，⼀方面反映北美CSP持續上修資本支出帶動雲端AI投資需求，另隨著AI
應用發展並延伸至其他領域(如Agentic AI 、 AI推論等) ， 將挹注半導體產業未來幾年展望正向且規模有望持續擴大 。

### Page 3

3
隨著AI晶片設計日趨複雜，加上採用先進封裝進⼀步墊高製作成本，使得KGD之重要性提升，帶動晶圓測試之測
試覆蓋率上升，使晶圓測試階段之測試時間、項目或測試要求均有提高，以此彰顯出測試左移(Shift-Left Testing)
之趨勢，尤其因應複雜的CPO技術，其所需之測試流程從前端晶圓到模組封裝共包含四個階段，透過在早期測試
階段剔除瑕疵，免除後續不必要的封裝成本並確保良率。
因應上述趨勢，使得探針卡規格也有所提升，加上AI晶片功率提升、尺寸放大、訊號傳輸速度要求提升等使得探
針卡設計挑戰持續增加。Yole預估2026年探針卡市場有望年增18.6%至37.2億美元，其中MEMS探針卡市場年增
約21.5%，其他市場則年增約11.9%，2025~2029年整體探針卡市場CAGR約10.9%，其中MEMS約12.8%，我們
推估主要由AI晶片、記憶體等需求帶動。而探針卡廠商中，FormFactor、Technoprobe、MJC⻑期位居前三名，
第四 、 五名則為旺矽 、 JEM ； 根據TechInsights統計 ， 上述廠商2024年市占依序為FormFactor 25% 、 Technoprobe

20%、MJC 14%、旺矽 8%、JEM 5%，且合計市占達60~70%，彰顯探針卡為高度集中市場。
| 營  運  概  況
AI 驅動近年營收、獲利顯著成⻑：受惠於公司新品布局效益(如探針卡、晶圓測試相關設備)、AI 強勁需求促使晶
圓針測機出貨成⻑同步挹注公司⼯程服務表現，帶動公司 2024 年以來營收均顯著成⻑，獲利亦持續改善，其中
1H26 達 21.9 億元，年增 114.5%，已達 2025 年全年營收 90%，毛利率 54.9%，稅後 EPS 21.5 元。
公司於晶圓測試階段廣泛布局：憑藉與日本設備廠之多年合作，使公司針對晶圓針測機具有豐富之裝機、改機經
驗，可因應客戶於晶圓測試階段之需求提供高度客製化的解決方案，而公司相關產品包含熱管理整合系統、白光

干涉光學檢測系統及熱載測試系統等，為公司目前最主要之產品別(客製化產品及代理設備)；另 2020 年切入之
探針卡領域，因營收基期較低故看好今明年成⻑動能顯著。
未來聚焦四大成⻑動能：展望後市，公司將瞄準四大方向進行布局，包含：(1)因應晶圓測試重要性提升，漢測提
供之高功率散熱模組可提升測試散熱效率，避免探針卡燒針故可改善晶圓測試穩定性；(2)公司回焊設備應用於
Bumping植球後之加熱回焊製程，而我們觀察主要大廠如台積電、日月光均持續擴充先進封裝產能，前者今明年
底CoWoS月產能分別為14~15/18~20萬片 、後者則為2~2.5/4.5~5.5萬片 ， 故在產能大幅擴充下暗示未來市場成
⻑空間龐大；(3)因應高速DRAM測試對於socket規格要求提升，將使得現行之Rubber socket面臨物理限制，故
公司將於台南Membrane探針卡廠區進行高速socket開發，預計1H27送樣；(4)CPO測試領域中，公司布局
insertion 1~3階段，產品包含insertion 1 快速對位方案，以及Insertion 2和3則與ficonTEC合作，而ficonTEC目

前為通過Nvidia Insertion 2測試的唯⼀設備廠但受限於產能有限，隱含未來漢測訂單展望明確，而漢測與
ficonTEC Insertion 2合作範圍已大致底定，包含從事OEM/ODM及後續裝機與售後服務。
| 評  價  分  析
公司同時具備半導體設備、探針卡等相關業務，而我們認為業務相近之國內同業包含旺矽、創新服務，前者業務
包含探針卡、半導體設備(如AST、溫控測試設備、CPO測試設備等)，後者業務則以半導體設備為大宗(如MEMS探
針卡植針機、MEMS探針卡自動化返修設備)，少部分來自於先進封裝高密度銅柱端⼦模組、探針卡材料包等；至
於國外同業FormFactor聚焦於探針卡製造，以及晶圓針測機、CPO測試設備等。
參考同業合理PE區間依序為旺矽30~47倍、創新服務25~40倍、FormFactor 22~44倍。我們考量AI晶片測試規
格提升，驅使晶圓測試重要性增加，而漢測於晶圓測試可提供多項服務(包含探針卡、設備、晶圓針測機裝機等)，
故認為其為AI趨勢成⻑下之受惠廠商之⼀；另基於公司和ficonTEC合作關係將使其可順利跨入CPO測試領域，將

有利評價維持高檔，故建議評價可參考同業PE區間上緣，我們初步給予目標價5,045元(47倍PER*2027EPS(F))。

要 原 因 ， 除 了 反 映 高 基 期 因 素 之 外 ， 部 分 可 歸 咎 為 鉅 額 資 本 支 出
對 四 大 CSP 財 務 衝 擊 日 益 擴 大。然 而，在AI Inference 、Agentic 
AI 、 自 研 ASIC 和新一代 AI 模 型 持 續 推 升 算 力 需 求 的 情 況 下 ， 預
期整體 CSP 投資金額將續創新高紀錄，產業成長有望從原先以
GPU 擴 張 為 主，轉 為 包 含AI server 、液 冷 散 熱、先 進 封 裝、高 速
互 聯 、 電 源 和 記 憶 體 等 基 礎 設 施 全 面 升 級 的 態 勢 。

一. 短期營收動能受缺料影響，但長期訂單展望無疑  
公 司 公 告8 月 營 收 24.57 億，MoM -0.2% ，YoY +40.5% ，今 年 累
計 營 收 198.48 億， YoY +51.7% 。 公 司 表 示 ， 第 三 季部 分 專 案受
到 物流 、 電 子 零 組 件 缺 料 影 響 ， 導 致部分 出 貨 時 程 與 營 收 認 列 遞
延 ， 但 從 客 戶 需 求 、 專 案 進 度 以 及 後 續 訂 單 來 看 ，仍預估 第三季
維 持 穩 健 向 上。 預 估 3Q26 營收 80.05 億元， QoQ +2.3% ，YoY 
+41.3% ，毛 利 率 30.9% ，營 利 率 22.5% ，稅 後 淨 利20.1 億，EPS 
11.21 元。

二. 預估 2026/2027 年稅後 EPS 47.01/65.97 元 
展望 2026 年，公 司 表 示，對下 半 年 整 體 景 氣 保 持 樂 觀，營 運 將 呈
現「 先 蹲 後 跳 」的 態 勢，全 年 展 望 維 持 穩 健 向 上 成 長，機櫃 (Rack )
產 品 線 去 年 佔 比 約5%-10% ，今年 預計將 提 升 至 10% 以 上 。 而 就
客戶 產 品 進 度 而言， NVIDIA Vera Rubin 預 計 第 三 季 如 期 推 出 ，
已 接 獲 大 量 訂 單 需 求。Vera CPU 產品也 已 進 入 準 量 產 階 段，預 計
今 年 下 半 年 如 期 上 市。另 外，AMD MI450 (Helios )伺 服 器 與 機 櫃 機
構 件 產 品， 按 照 開 發 排 程 ， 預 計 於 今 年 底 上 市 。而 產 能 部 分 ， 馬
來 西 亞 廠以機殼 (chassis )為 主 ， 預 計 第 三 季底 產能 開始 爬坡。美
國 德 州 達 拉 斯 廠， 預 計 明 年 第 三 季 開 始 進 入 量 產 ， 主 要 支 援 美 系
客 戶 機 櫃 與 水 冷CDU 需 求。此 外，公 司 亦 宣 布 越 南 擴 廠 計 畫，初
期 採 租 賃 方 式 加 速 投 產 ， 定 位 為 機 櫃 產 品 線， 最快 將於 第 四 季 至
明 年 第 一 季量產 。 預估 2026 營收 326.7 億 元 ，YoY +48.5% ，毛

馬 來 西 亞 及 美 國 新 廠 明 年 陸 續 放 量 ，將 持 續 挹 注 公 司 營 運 動 能 。

產業：電機機械 
2026 年營運平淡，未來關注新業務部門挹注 
 投資評價與建議 
研究部預估未來四季EPS為6.22元，預期本益比落在22倍，公司過往本益比區
間約落在15～30倍，考量到目前⾞用成⻑較為平穩，加上新業務仍需時間貢
獻，因此評價位於合理區間，靜待工業產品放量。 
 重點評論分析 
預期3Q26營運平穩 ：八月營收月減3.5%至6.4億元 ， 預期終端客戶拉貨動能因
⾞市疲弱而趨緩，獲利部分，銅價約有四成客戶未綁定銅價影響上半年毛利約
0.8~1ppts，且原物料並無下降趨勢，導致獲利要重回正常水準仍具挑戰性，
因此預估3Q26營收季增約1.5%達20.6億元，毛利率27.2%，稅後EPS 1.47元。 
產品線與車市相關性高，靜待新部門放量：展望未來，⾞用二極體業務與⾞市
相關性較高，而目前⾞市較為成熟，成⻑有限，傳統油⾞受到新能源⾞排擠，
因此預期傳統二極體占比預期將從 2025年的29%降至22%，高效能二極體則
從28%降至25% ， 產品轉向超高效能二極體 ， 且ULLD的單價為⼀般產品的6倍 ，
能帶動公司產品組合優化；48V MOSFET模組，因歐洲客戶拉貨及導入速度略
低於預期，動能來自於新工業部門產品包含了：(1)IGBT：切入數位相機市場，
公司表示 ， 4Q26會開始放量150K/月 ， 2027年預計可提升至800k顆/季 ； (2)SiC
模組：包含了650V/1200V/1700V模組，預計在2027年量產，基於以上，預期
2026年營運較為平淡 ， 2027年新部門放量改善產品組合 ， 帶動公司營運向上 。  
 投資風險 
原物料波動劇烈、新業務部門進度不如預期。

歐洲地區分別占約 33%及 14%，且 OICA 統計，2024 年全球汽⾞銷量年增 2.7%達約 9,531 萬輛，其中乘用⾞占
比最大共銷售 6,754 萬輛占 70.9%，商用⾞則銷售 2,777 萬輛占 29.1%，而依照 S&P Global 數據，2025 年輕
型⾞(總⾞輛重量額定值在約 4,536 公斤或以下的⾞輛)約為 9,170 萬輛，高於 2024 年的 8,820 萬輛，顯示全球
汽⾞市場雖受到新冠疫情、供應鏈中斷及關稅政策影響，但仍保持穩健的復甦。 
圖表、全球汽⾞市場規模         單位：十億美元  圖表、歷史汽⾞銷售                   單位：千輛

資料來源：Toward Automotive、OICA、S&P Global 
受惠於減少碳排放趨勢，推動電動車市場成⻑：對於減少碳排放，多個國家的政府鼓勵使用電動⾞，成為推動電
動⾞成⻑的主要因素，根據 BloombergNEF 統計，電動⾞銷量從 2021 年的 647 萬輛成⻑到 2025 年約 2,056 萬
輛 ， 占乘用⾞的銷量已來到 26.5% ， 也顯示消費者已漸漸轉向購買電動⾞ ， 不過隨著規模擴大成⻑率也逐漸收斂 ，
且可觀察各國電動⾞占比也能發現，電動⾞在不同國家的接受度呈現分層態勢，其中荷蘭的滲透率在 12 月已達
75%，展現出強勁的轉型力道；中國則憑藉穩定的市場競爭力，全年維持在 50%至 60%的高位區間；相較之下，
美國的電動化進程最為緩慢，占比低於 15%，12M25 更落在約 8%的低點。

朋程(8255)為車用二極體研發與製造大廠，市占約50%以上：朋程於1998年成立，公司專注於⾞用二極體的研發
與製造，根據公司年報，全球⾞用整流二極體市佔率約50%以上，產品包含標準型二極體(LLD)、高效能二極體及
超高效能二極體(ULLD)，主要應用在燃油⾞的發電機，將引擎產生出來交流電轉換為直流電後，儲存於電瓶，因
⾞輛結構不同，運用6~12顆/⾞，而在新能源⾞上，公司則提供SiC和GaN模組切入市場，客戶包含了各地區的汽
⾞零件Tier 1廠商 ， 而近期因環保法規積極推動減碳 ， 因此二極體規格逐漸轉為ULLD ， 使產品占比逐漸偏向ULLD ，
預估2026年ULLD占比約36%，LLD、傳統⾞用二極體及xEV分別為25%、22%及17%。 
圖表、歷年產品比重 圖表、產品類別比重

資料來源：朋程 
| 營運概況  
2Q26 因產能利用率提高帶動獲利回穩，3Q26 有望進入旺季而維持營運狀況：朋程 2Q26 營收季減 0.3%至 20.3
億元，受到海外客戶疲弱以及電動⾞相關產品於歐洲導入較慢影響，毛利率達 26.98%，與上季持平，主要因銅價
(約有四成客戶未綁定銅價影響約 0.8~1ppts)，稅後淨利率 6.24%，EPS 1.44 元，展望 3Q26，八月自結營收月減
3.5%至 6.4 億元，預期終端客戶拉貨動能因⾞市疲弱而趨緩，且原物料波動並未有下降趨勢，導致獲利要重回正
常水準仍具挑戰性，因此預估 3Q26 營收季增約 1.5%達 20.6 億元，毛利率 27.2%，稅後 EPS 1.47 元。 
展望未來，公司二極體主要應用在燃油發電機，市占穩定在 50%~55%，較容易受到⾞市銷量波動，而目前⾞市
較為成熟，全球輕型汽⾞銷售多落在 8,500 至 9,500 萬輛之間，成⻑有限，傳統油⾞受到新能源排擠以及因應環
保法規二極體將往更高效率產品做導入，使傳統二極體占比預期將從 2025 年的 29%降至 22%，且出貨量落在約
1.3 億~1.4 億顆(YoY-9%) ； 高效能二極體(LLD)則從 28%降至 25% ， 出貨量預期落在 7,200 萬至 7,500 萬顆(YoY-
9%)，產品轉向超高效能二極體(ULLD)，目前訂單及產能利用率皆滿載，需求較爲強勁，預計出貨量落在 4,000 萬
~4,200 萬顆(YoY+20%)，且公司表示 ULLD 的單價為⼀般產品的 6 倍，預期能帶動公司產品組合優化，占比從
21%提升至 36%，2027 年研究部預期趨勢仍往超高效能二極體做導入銷量有望年增 20%，傳統及高效能則呈現
年減；而用於混合能源⾞的 48V MOSFET 模組，2025 年新增的第三條產線目前已完成建置與驗證，年產能可提
升至 450 萬套，但歐洲客戶拉貨及導入速度略低於預期，產能利用率較低，而公司近期策略性佈局自研晶片，因
晶圓代工成本飆漲，經濟效益較差，且⾞用合約較⻑，轉嫁的難度較高，因此將延後推進，使 48V MOSFET 模組
毛利成⻑有限，基於以上既有產品線展望，預期 2026 年營運較為平淡，2027 年將隨⾞市回溫以及混合電動⾞的
滲透率提高，帶動公司營運向上。

邁出步伐、積糧築牆 
投資與評價 
1. 智易 2Q26 受惠歐美電信客戶追加定單，獲利為近 3 季新高；智易 3Q26
則因歐美電信商客戶需求持續穩定成長，獲利為歷史新高。 
2. 北美需求穩定成長與亞洲新興市場基建擴張，歐洲市場亦趨於穩定、緩步
回升 ， 在企業用戶與衛星產品投產貢獻下 ， 營運續創新高 ， 預估26 年 EPS 
13.69 元、27 年 EPS 16.03 元。 
3. 目前智易股價 155.0 元，約為 9.7X FY27E EPS ，位於近 3 年 PER 參考區
間 9~21X 下緣位置，考量 26 年與 27 年營運可望續創新高，若以預估之
27 年現金股利 11.22 元與 26 年現金股利 9.58 元計算，現金殖利率則為
7.2 %與 6.2%， 皆具有殖利率題材誘因 ， 維持買進投資評等 ，目標價 195.0
元(12X 修正後 FY27E EPS)。 
重點更新 
智易 2Q26 受惠電信商追加訂單需求，獲利為近 3 季新高 
智易 2Q26 受惠大型電信商與 MSO 客戶因擔憂記憶體價格壓力延續至 27 年
之後 ， 已開始追加訂單 ， 部分客戶亦願意支付缺料成本及倉儲費 ， 以確保供貨 ，
營收為 138.82 億元(+8.6% QoQ)，與預估相近。記憶體成本轉嫁已有進展，
部分客戶採直接調價，部分採季度結算，營業毛利率為 15.2%與 1Q26 相近，
營業費用 11.78 億元(+5.6% QoQ)，營業費用率 8.5%，與預估之 8.6%相近，
營業淨利季增 12.9%至 9.29 億元，略低於預估之 9.58 億元(+16.5% QoQ) 
3.0%。因利息收入貢獻穩定，2Q26 業外收益為 0.66 億元，稅後淨利 7.43 億
元(+8.0% QoQ)，略高於預估之 7.33 億元(+6.5% QoQ)，EPS 3.38 元，獲利
為近 3 季新高。 
智易 3Q26 受惠歐美電信商客戶需求穩定成長，預期營運為歷史新高 
智易 3Q26 因歐美電信商客戶持續拉貨，且智慧家庭產品需求亦持續，推升 7
月營收至 48.47 億元(+2.3% MoM)創下歷史次高後，即使因上游零組件受 AI
產能排擠導致價格上漲 ， 交期拉長 ， 出貨遞延關係 ，8 月營收出現小幅月減 2.4%
至 47.32 億元，未能再度創高，但預期9 月營收將再度回升，維持與原預估相
近之營收 144.15 億元(+3.8% QoQ) ，營業毛利率將較 2Q26 略微上升至
15.5%， 營業淨利預估為10.56億元(+13.7% QoQ)， 稅後淨利7.96 億元(+7.1% 
QoQ)，EPS 3.62 元，營運將為歷史新高。

智易 2Q26 受惠電信商追加訂單需求，獲利為近 3 季新高 
智易 2Q26 受惠大型電信商與 MSO 客戶因擔憂記憶體價格壓力延續至 27 年之後，已開始追加
訂單 ， 部分客戶亦願意支付缺料成本及倉儲費 ， 以確保供貨 ， 營收為138.82 億元(+8.6% QoQ)，
與預估之 140.71 億元(+10.1% QoQ)相近。

記憶體成本轉嫁已有進展，部分客戶採直接調價，部分採季度結算，且1Q26 部分轉嫁款項尚未
入帳，移至本季結算，但因記憶體漲價持續、被動元件等成本亦隨之提升，營業毛利率為15.2%
與 1Q26 相近 ， 但略低於預估之15.4%。 營業費用11.78 億元(+5.6% QoQ)， 營業費用率8.5%，
與預估之 8.6%相近 ， 營業淨利季增12.9%至 9.29 億元 ， 略低於預估之9.58 億元(+16.5% QoQ) 
3.0%。由於利息收入貢獻穩定 ，2Q26 業外收益為 0.66 億元 ， 稅後淨利7.43 億元(+8.0% QoQ)，
略高於預估之 7.33 億元(+6.5% QoQ) 1.4%，EPS 3.38 元，獲利為近 3 季新高。

預期北美電信與企業用戶市場需求續增，帶動智易 26 年營運創歷史新高 
預期 26 年北美電信商依舊持續推廣 FWA 寬頻連網方案，依然與 Cable 廠商競爭家用連網市佔，
為智易主要營運成長動能不變，歐洲市場如英國、德國與法國等家用接取產品的佈建需求，從家
用路由器至閘道器等產品皆有新方案推出，企業用戶產品需求持續暢旺，但受記憶體產品漲價影
響 ， 使亞洲電信商客戶在CPE 相關產品的佈建與需求受到些許排擠 ， 故微調降26 年營收預估 1.2%
至 552.20 億元(+4.2% YoY)。

因關鍵零組件庫存成本配置得宜，公司已提前備足至 27 年的客戶訂單需求，也向記憶體廠下單與
鎖定價格但尚未入帳，因與客戶談妥價格轉嫁協議，預期對營業毛利率衝擊較小，使 1H26 毛利
率皆維持在 15%以上之水準，受零組件劇烈漲價影響有限，26 年整體毛利率預估為 15.4%，因研
發費用支出降低，營業費用率維略為調低至 8.4%，營業淨利則年增 9.2%至 38.22 億元，稅後淨
利預估為 30.15 億元(+8.7% YoY)，EPS 13.69 元，營運續增。

因企業用戶需求強勁與新增衛星傳輸產品，預期智易 27 年營運再度創高 
預期 27 年北美電信商需求穩定增長，依舊推廣 FWA 寬頻連網方案爭奪家用連網商機，但智易除
電信客戶以外，尚有開發企業用網通及企業用資安產品，主要提供客戶一站式購足的完整解決方
案，從無線應用產品至有線網管產品皆囊括，並於 1H27 逐步放量出貨，再加上耕耘許久之衛星
產品亦開始出貨 ， 也將挹注營收成長 ， 為公司首度打入衛星產品市場 ， 預期Mobility 與 Broadband
產品營收迎來新興成長動能，維持與原預估相近之 27 年整體營收年增 11.1%至 613.69 億元，營
業毛利率走升至 15.7%，營業費用率則降至 8.1%，預估營業淨利年增 21.5%至 46.44 億元，稅後
淨利預估為 35.21 億元(+16.8% YoY)，EPS 16.03 元，營運再創歷史新高。

因北美客戶與歐洲市場需求趨於穩定，營運逐年走升 
智易 2Q26 受惠歐美電信客戶追加定單，獲利為近 3 季新高；智易 3Q26 則因歐美電信商客戶需
求持續穩定成長，獲利為歷史新高。北美加速縮小城鄉差距與減少固網覆蓋盲區，用戶對於傳輸
速度需求提高，電信業者升級客戶終端設備來達成拉高 ARPU 的經營方式未曾停歇。北美需求穩
定成長與亞洲新興市場基建擴張，歐洲市場亦趨於穩定、緩步回升，在企業用戶與衛星產品投產
貢獻下，營運續創新高，預估 26 年 EPS 13.69 元、27 年 EPS 16.03 元。

目前智易股價 155.5 元，約為 9.7X FY27E EPS，位於近 3 年 PER 參考區間 9~21X 下緣位置，考
量 26 年與 27 年營運可望續創新高，若以預估之 27 年現金股利 11.22 元與 26 年現金股利 9.58
元計算，現金殖利率則為 7.2 %與 6.2%，皆具有殖利率題材誘因，維持買進投資評等。因時序邁
入產業旺季末段、準備進入產業淡季，故將本益評價由平均值之 15 倍略降至中間偏下之 12 倍，
目標價由 235.0 元(15X 修正前 FY27E EPS)調低至 195.0 元(12X 修正後 FY27E EPS)。

公司簡介 
智易科技股份有限公司成立於 2003 年 5 月 9 日，公司是由飛利浦與智邦合資設立，2006 年初智
邦將飛利浦持有的股權買下，智易則成為智邦持股 100%子公司，同年 8 月智邦將智易近七成的
股權出售予仁寶，公司現在隸屬於仁寶集團旗下，仁寶為公司主要股東。 
公司為網通設備製造廠商之一，早期經營模式主要替品牌廠商進行代工，在由品牌廠商銷售給電
信營運商客戶，從2007 年公司開始轉向直接出貨給電信營運商客戶，毛利率較一般代工好。公司
也已發展為全球最大 IAD 製造商，市佔率超過二成。 
2Q26 營收佔比為 Smart Home Solution 31.7%、Broadband Solution 26.4%、Mobility Solution 
38.1%、Others 3.7%。

智易 ESG 政策 
1. 環境：是智易認為企業追求營運及成長時，絕不可忽略的重要項目之一。唯有環境、經濟、社
會共存共榮，才能有永續的企業。為避免營運對環境產生負面衝擊，截至2019 年為止，智易已導
入 TL9000、ISO9001 品質管理、ISO14001 環境管理及 OHSAS 18001 安全衛生管理等多項相關
認證。同時，智易研發團隊特別關注產品綠色設計，已成功導入無鉛製程，更完成鉛、鎘、汞、六
價鉻等禁用物質管制規範，並推行 ISO 14006 產品生態化設計管理系統，落實產品生態化設計
（Eco-design） ，建立系統性的管理體系，有效追蹤與管制各項環境績效。 
2. 綠色產品：智易產品的綠色設計思維奠基於「產品生命週期（Product Life Cycle, PLC） 」 ，考量
原料採購、生產製造、運輸配送、消費者使用到棄置回收等各個生命週期階段的環境衝擊。因此，
在產品設計之初，除注重客戶需求、功能性、節能低碳設計符合各國銷售地區法規，如歐盟耗能產
品生態設計指令外，強化綠色概念的產品設計核心方向為 「材料選用低毒」 、 「省能設計」 及 「易拆
解回收少包裝」 。同時配合國際趨勢與利害相關者和顧客需求，進行環境友善設計，以達最佳的生
態效益（Eco-effectiveness）。 
3. 無鹵素（Halogen-Free） ：鹵素經燃燒廢棄後可能會產生劇毒性的戴奧辛，歐盟於有害物質限
用指令（Restriction of Hazardous Substances, RoHS）中針對溴系阻燃劑（PBB、PBDEs）已列
入控管。面對國際組織倡導 「無鹵素零件及製程」 及客戶更積極性的環保需求，智易秉持減少環境
負荷及降低人體危害的設計，於零件及原料環境相關管制物質管理相關規定中，明確定義無鹵產
品當中氯與溴含量限制及管制範圍，並逐步建構無鹵素產品生產製造能力。近年由於各大品牌客
戶均朝向全無鹵的環保規格方向邁進，智易將持續努力提升材料設計能力，配合市場趨勢加速汰
換含鹵材料。 
4. 員工結構概況：至 2019 年 12 月底，智易新竹研發總部與各中心員工總人數共 2,909 人，智
易全球人數男女性整體任用為男性佔 51.1%，女性佔 48.9%。智易台灣地區含新竹總部、台北辦
公室以及駐外員工總人數共 650 人，研發人力佔公司員工人數超過五成，智易員工男女性整體任
用為男性佔 72.0%，女性佔 28.0%；管理職位男性佔 79.0%，女性佔 21.0%，係因職務類型、科
系背景等因素，而導致比例差異，並非因性別影響雇用或升遷機會。CNC 大陸生產中心員工總人
數共 1,190 人，男性佔 55.6%，女性佔 44.4%；AVC 越南生產中心員工總人數共 1,069 人，男性
佔 33.1%，女性佔 66.9%。 
5. 董事會為公司最高治理單位及重大經營決策的中心，其職責包括任命與監督公司管理階層、監
督經營績效、防制利益衝突及確保公司遵循各種法令法規規定，並保障股東權益。智易共有十名
董事 ， 並於股東常會選任三名獨立董事 ， 並由此三名獨立董事組成薪資報酬委員會與審計委員會 ，
協助評估、核定與監督公司營運績效，獨董比例為三成。2019 年董事會共有 7 次會議，實際出席
率平均為 84.9%。

首次評等  
增加持股(Overweight) 
房市管制逐漸鬆綁，房仲本業逐漸復甦  
⚫ 房仲本業逐 漸復甦，部份門店翻新 提升客戶提驗與品牌形 象  
⚫ 開發案 銷售 入帳認列貢獻營運轉虧為盈  
⚫ 房市政策逐 漸鬆綁有利房市築底 ，且評價面相對偏低  
信義房屋 2Q26 獲利呈現轉虧為盈 ：2Q26 財報合併營收 30.60 億元，
較去年同期成長 33%，主要成長來自於信義房屋 貢獻增加 4.86 億元 ，
約成長 25% ，以及大陸開發因「山水嘉庭」案調整銷售計畫後而持續
帶動銷售動能，營收貢獻增加 3.08 億元；營業利益 3.78 億元，較去
年同期轉虧為盈 ， 營業利益率 (OPM) 回升至 12.36%， 較上季度回升 5.08
個百分點， 2Q26 稅後歸母公司獲利 3.29 億元，較去年同期轉虧為盈，
2Q26 單季稅後 EPS0.45 元；公司自結累計 01~0 8/2026 合併營收 77.69
億元，較去年同期成長 29.67 %。 
全台總店鋪 430 間，部份門店翻新提升客戶提驗與品牌形象 ：1H26
各事業營運分布方面信義房屋佔 71% 、國內非開發事業 5%、日本信
義 5%、國內開發事業 10%、大陸開發事業 7%及大陸非開發事業 2%；
信義房屋總店鋪數截至 07/2026 約 430 間，雙北地區 247 間、桃竹地
區 62 間、台中地區 63 間及南高地區 58 間，總店鋪數較 04/2026 減少
6 間，各地區門店約減少 1~2 間，整體店數減少主因公司策略性調整，
部分自有資產門店因門 店設施老舊翻新以提升客戶體驗及品牌形象。  
房市管制措施逐漸鬆綁， 房市展望築底復甦趨勢 ： 最新 2Q26 信義房
價指數 168.77 點，降上季度 成長 0.74% ，較去年同期成長 2.66% ，目
前需求仍以自用為主，目前經濟表現動能強近，目前已進入打底期，
估計一段時間後築底復甦，進入緩步復甦的階段，雙北市況相對穩
定；對於 「青安  3.0 」 政策上路 ，公司預 期對 於首購族 較具吸引 力，
政策對於整體市場影響是好的，觀察後續 4Q 旺季復甦動能 ，央行將
第二戶房貸成數上限從 6 成拉高至 7 成，可望帶動換屋需求復甦 。 
評價面 仍相對偏低 ：信義房屋 房仲業本業逐漸穩定復甦，開發事業貢
獻營收成長 ，馬林松酒店預計於 2027 年底正式營運將貢獻新業務收
入；投顧預估 信義 2026/2027 /2028 年營收 114.68/104.79/117.31 億元，
獲利預估 2026/2027 /2028 稅後 EPS 至 1.0 6/0.83/1.2 3 元，預估至 2027
年底每股淨值 19.24 元，目前 PBR 約 1.08 倍；評價面過往 3 年信義股
價淨值比 (PBR) 評價介於 1.02~2.05 倍，平均 PBR 約 1.56 倍，目標價
23 元(2027 P BR 1.2 倍)。 
風險因子： 總體經濟成長趨緩，房市成交量復甦不 如預期 。
